यः सर्वशास्त्रनीतिज्ञः शुचिः शौर्यसमन्वितः ।
तस्माज् ज्ञात्वा तु तां देवीं वर्णतो रूपतो गुणैः ॥ 92.18 ॥

91.s:
parākrameṇa śauryeṇa śauṇḍīryeṇa balena ca .
bandhuvargeṇa sāmagrya sthānena karaṇena ca .
evaṃ jñātvā tu tāṃ devīṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ vidhīyatām .. 92.19 ..
91.d:
पराक्रमेण शौर्येण शौण्डीर्येण बलेन च ।
बन्धुवर्गेण सामग्र्य स्थानेन करणेन च ।
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु तां देवीं ततः कार्यं विधीयताम् ॥ 92.19 ॥

91.s:
tataḥ sapadi daityasya tadvacaḥ sādhu sādhviti .
praśaśaṃsurvarārohe vighasaṃ mantrisattamam .. 92.20 ..
91.d:
ततः सपदि दैत्यस्य तद्वचः साधु साध्विति ।
प्रशशंसुर्वरारोहे विघसं मन्त्रिसत्तमम् ॥ 92.20 ॥

91.s:
praśasya sarve taṃ dūtaṃ saṃdeṣṭumupacakramuḥ .
vidyutprabhaṃ mahābhāgaṃ mahāmāyāvidaṃ śubham .. 92.21 ..
91.d:
प्रशस्य सर्वे तं दूतं संदेष्टुमुपचक्रमुः ।
विद्युत्प्रभं महाभागं महामायाविदं शुभम् ॥ 92.21 ॥

91.s:
visarjayitvā taṃ dūtaṃ vighaso vākyamabravīt .
saṃnahyantāṃ dānavendrāścaturaṅgabalena ha .
kriyatāṃ vijayastāvad devasainyaṃ prati prabho .. 92.22 ..
91.d:
विसर्जयित्वा तं दूतं विघसो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
संनह्यन्तां दानवेन्द्राश्चतुरङ्गबलेन ह ।
क्रियतां विजयस्तावद् देवसैन्यं प्रति प्रभो ॥ 92.22 ॥

91.s:
asurendra surairbhagnaistat parākramabhīṣitā .
sā kanyā vaśatāmeti tvayi śakrasamāgate .. 92.23 ..
91.d:
असुरेन्द्र सुरैर्भग्नैस्तत् पराक्रमभीषिता ।
सा कन्या वशतामेति त्वयि शक्रसमागते ॥ 92.23 ॥

91.s:
lokapālairjitaiḥ sarvaistathaiva marutāṃ gaṇaiḥ .
nāgairvidyādharaiḥ siddhairgandharvaiḥ sarvato jitaiḥ .
rudrairvasubhirādityaistvamevendro bhaviṣyasi .. 92.24 ..
91.d:
लोकपालैर्जितैः सर्वैस्तथैव मरुतां गणैः ।
नागैर्विद्याधरैः सिद्धैर्गन्धर्वैः सर्वतो जितैः ।
रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैस्त्वमेवेन्द्रो भविष्यसि ॥ 92.24 ॥

91.s:
indrasya te śataṃ kanyā devagandharvayoṣitaḥ .
vaśamāyānti sā'pi syāt sarvathā vaśamāgatā .. 92.25 ..
91.d:
इन्द्रस्य ते शतं कन्या देवगन्धर्वयोषितः ।
वशमायान्ति साऽपि स्यात् सर्वथा वशमागता ॥ 92.25 ॥

91.s:
evamuktastadā daityaḥ senāpatimuvāca ha .
virūpākṣaṃ mahāmeghavarṇaṃ nīlāñjanaprabham .. 92.26 ..
91.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा दैत्यः सेनापतिमुवाच ह ।
विरूपाक्षं महामेघवर्णं नीलाञ्जनप्रभम् ॥ 92.26 ॥

91.s:
ānīyatāṃ drutaṃ sainyaṃ hastyaśvarathapattinām .
yena devān sagandharvān jayāmi yudhi durjjayān .. 92.27 ..
91.d:
आनीयतां द्रुतं सैन्यं हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिनाम् ।
येन देवान् सगन्धर्वान् जयामि युधि दुर्ज्जयान् ॥ 92.27 ॥

91.s:
evamukte virūpākṣastadā senāpatirdrutam .
ānināya mahatsainyamanantamaparājitam .. 92.28 ..
91.d:
एवमुक्ते विरूपाक्षस्तदा सेनापतिर्द्रुतम् ।
आनिनाय महत्सैन्यमनन्तमपराजितम् ॥ 92.28 ॥

91.s:
ekaiko dānavastatra vajrahastasamo yudhi .
ekaikaṃ spardhate devaṃ jetuṃ svena balena ha .. 92.29 ..
91.d:
एकैको दानवस्तत्र वज्रहस्तसमो युधि ।
एकैकं स्पर्धते देवं जेतुं स्वेन बलेन ह ॥ 92.29 ॥

91.s:
teṣāṃ pradhānabhūtānāmarbudaṃ navakoṭayaḥ .
yeṣāmekasyānuyāti tāvad balamarthorjjitam .. 92.30 ..
91.d:
तेषां प्रधानभूतानामर्बुदं नवकोटयः ।
येषामेकस्यानुयाति तावद् बलमर्थोर्ज्जितम् ॥ 92.30 ॥

91.s:
teṣāṃ naikasahastrāṇi daityānāṃ tu mahātmanām .
samitiṃ cakruravyagrāstadā daityāḥ prahāriṇaḥ .
prayāṇaṃ kārayāmāsurdevasainyajighāṃsayā .. 92.31 ..
91.d:
तेषां नैकसहस्त्राणि दैत्यानां तु महात्मनाम् ।
समितिं चक्रुरव्यग्रास्तदा दैत्याः प्रहारिणः ।
प्रयाणं कारयामासुर्देवसैन्यजिघांसया ॥ 92.31 ॥

91.s:
vicitrayānā vividhadhvajāgrā
vicitraśastrā vividhograrūpāḥ .
daityā surāñ jetumicchanta uccair
nanartturāttāyudhabhīmahastāḥ .. 92.32 ..
91.d:
विचित्रयाना विविधध्वजाग्रा
विचित्रशस्त्रा विविधोग्ररूपाः ।
दैत्या सुराञ् जेतुमिच्छन्त उच्चैर्
ननर्त्तुरात्तायुधभीमहस्ताः ॥ 92.32 ॥

91.s: .. iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 92 ..
91.d: ॥ इति श्रीवराहपुराणे भगवच्छास्त्रे द्विनवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 92 ॥
91.m: Thus ends the ninety-first chapter in the venerable Varāha Purāṇa, a scripture of the Lord.

92.s:
śrīvarāha uvāca .
tato mahiṣadaityastu kāmarūpī mahābalaḥ .
mattahastināmāruhya yiyāsurmeruparvatam .. 93.1 ..
92.d:
श्रीवराह उवाच ।
ततो महिषदैत्यस्तु कामरूपी महाबलः ।
मत्तहस्तिनामारुह्य यियासुर्मेरुपर्वतम् ॥ 93.1 ॥

92.s:
tatraindraṃ puramāsādya devaiḥ saha śatakratum .
abhidudrāva daityendrastato devāḥ krudhānvitāḥ .. 93.2 ..
92.d:
तत्रैन्द्रं पुरमासाद्य देवैः सह शतक्रतुम् ।
अभिदुद्राव दैत्येन्द्रस्ततो देवाः क्रुधान्विताः ॥ 93.2 ॥

92.s:
ādāya svāni śastrāṇi vāhanāni viśeṣataḥ .
adhiṣṭhāyāsurānājau dudruvurmuditā bhṛśam .. 93.3 ..
92.d:
आदाय स्वानि शस्त्राणि वाहनानि विशेषतः ।
अधिष्ठायासुरानाजौ दुद्रुवुर्मुदिता भृशम् ॥ 93.3 ॥

92.s:
teṣāṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam .
ghoraṃ pracaṇḍayodhānāmanyonyamabhigarjatām .. 93.4 ..
92.d:
तेषां प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ।
घोरं प्रचण्डयोधानामन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम् ॥ 93.4 ॥

92.s:
tatrāñjano nīlakukṣirmeghavarṇo balāhakaḥ .
udarākṣo lalāṭākṣaḥ subhīmo bhīmavikramaḥ .
svarbhānuśceti daityāṣṭau vasūn dudruvurāhave .. 93.5 ..
92.d:
तत्राञ्जनो नीलकुक्षिर्मेघवर्णो बलाहकः ।
उदराक्षो ललाटाक्षः सुभीमो भीमविक्रमः ।
स्वर्भानुश्चेति दैत्याष्टौ वसून् दुद्रुवुराहवे ॥ 93.5 ॥

92.s:
yathāsaṃkhyena tadvacca daityā dvādaśa cāpare .
ādityān daityavaryāstu teṣāṃ prādhānyataḥ śrṛṇu .. 93.6 ..
92.d:
यथासंख्येन तद्वच्च दैत्या द्वादश चापरे ।
आदित्यान् दैत्यवर्यास्तु तेषां प्राधान्यतः श्रृणु ॥ 93.6 ॥

92.s:
bhīmo dhvaṅkṣo dhvastakarṇaḥ śaṅkukarṇastathaiva ca .
vajrakāyo'tivīryaśca vidyunmālī tathaiva ca .. 93.7 ..
92.d:
भीमो ध्वङ्क्षो ध्वस्तकर्णः शङ्कुकर्णस्तथैव च ।
वज्रकायोऽतिवीर्यश्च विद्युन्माली तथैव च ॥ 93.7 ॥

92.s:
raktākṣo bhīmadaṃṣṭrastu vidyujjihvastathaiva ca .
atikāyo mahākāyo dīrghabāhuḥ kṛtāntakaḥ .. 93.8 ..
92.d:
रक्ताक्षो भीमदंष्ट्रस्तु विद्युज्जिह्वस्तथैव च ।
अतिकायो महाकायो दीर्घबाहुः कृतान्तकः ॥ 93.8 ॥

92.s:
ete dvādaśa daityendrā ādityān yudhi dudruvuḥ .
svakaṃ sainyamupādāya tadvadanye'pi dānavāḥ .
rudrān dudruvuravyagrā yathāsaṃkhyena kopitāḥ .. 93.9 ..
92.d:
एते द्वादश दैत्येन्द्रा आदित्यान् युधि दुद्रुवुः ।
स्वकं सैन्यमुपादाय तद्वदन्येऽपि दानवाः ।
रुद्रान् दुद्रुवुरव्यग्रा यथासंख्येन कोपिताः ॥ 93.9 ॥

92.s:
kālaḥ kṛtānto raktākṣo haraṇo mitrahā'nilaḥ .
yajñahā brahmahā goghnaḥ strīghnaḥ saṃvarttakastathā .. 93.10 ..
92.d:
कालः कृतान्तो रक्ताक्षो हरणो मित्रहाऽनिलः ।
यज्ञहा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः स्त्रीघ्नः संवर्त्तकस्तथा ॥ 93.10 ॥

92.s:
ityete daśa caikaśca daityendrā yuddhadurmadāḥ .
yathāsaṃkhyena rudrāṃstu dudruvurbhīmavikramāḥ .. 93.11 ..
92.d:
इत्येते दश चैकश्च दैत्येन्द्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः ।
यथासंख्येन रुद्रांस्तु दुद्रुवुर्भीमविक्रमाः ॥ 93.11 ॥

92.s:
śeṣān devān śeṣadaityā yathāyogamupādravan .
svayaṃ mahiṣadaityastu indraṃ dudrāva vegitaḥ .. 93.12 ..
92.d:
शेषान् देवान् शेषदैत्या यथायोगमुपाद्रवन् ।
स्वयं महिषदैत्यस्तु इन्द्रं दुद्राव वेगितः ॥ 93.12 ॥

92.s:
sa cāpi balavān daityo brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ .
avadhyaḥ puruṣeṇājau yadyapi syāt pinākadhṛk .. 93.13 ..
92.d:
स चापि बलवान् दैत्यो ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पितः ।
अवध्यः पुरुषेणाजौ यद्यपि स्यात् पिनाकधृक् ॥ 93.13 ॥

92.s:
ādityairvasubhiḥ sādhyai rudraiśca nihatā bhṛśam .
asurā yātudhānāśca saṃkhyāpūraṇakevalāḥ .. 93.14 ..
92.d:
आदित्यैर्वसुभिः साध्यै रुद्रैश्च निहता भृशम् ।
असुरा यातुधानाश्च संख्यापूरणकेवलाः ॥ 93.14 ॥

92.s:
devānāmapi sainyāni nihatānyasurairyudhi .
evaṃ bhūte tadā bhagne devendre vidrutāḥ surāḥ .. 93.15 ..
92.d:
देवानामपि सैन्यानि निहतान्यसुरैर्युधि ।
एवं भूते तदा भग्ने देवेन्द्रे विद्रुताः सुराः ॥ 93.15 ॥

92.s:
arditā vividhaiḥ śastraiḥ śūlapaṭṭiśamudgaraiḥ .
gatavanto brahmalokamasurairarditāḥ surāḥ .. 93.16 ..
92.d:
अर्दिता विविधैः शस्त्रैः शूलपट्टिशमुद्गरैः ।
गतवन्तो ब्रह्मलोकमसुरैरर्दिताः सुराः ॥ 93.16 ॥

92.m:
Thus ends the ninety-second chapter in the glorious Varāhapurāṇa, a scripture of the Lord.

Thus ends the ninety-third chapter in the glorious Varāhapurāṇa, a scripture of the Lord.

93.s:
śrīvarāha uvāca .
atha vidyutprabho daityastathā dūto visarjitaḥ .
devyāḥ sakāśaṃ gatvā'sau tāmuvāca sumadhyamām .. 94.1 ..
93.d:
श्रीवराह उवाच ।
अथ विद्युत्प्रभो दैत्यस्तथा दूतो विसर्जितः ।
देव्याः सकाशं गत्वाऽसौ तामुवाच सुमध्यमाम् ॥ 94.1 ॥
93.m: The glorious Varāha said: / Then the Daitya Vidyutprabha, dispatched as a messenger in that manner, / went into the presence of the goddess and spoke to that slender-waisted lady.

93.s:
praṇamya prayato bhūtvā kumārīśatasaṃkulām .
āsthāne vinayāpannastato vacanamabravīt .. 94.2 ..
93.d:
प्रणम्य प्रयतो भूत्वा कुमारीशतसंकुलाम् ।
आस्थाने विनयापन्नस्ततो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 94.2 ॥
93.m: Having bowed and composed himself, filled with humility / in the assembly hall crowded with hundreds of maidens, he then spoke these words.

93.s:
vidyutprabha uvāca .
devi pūrvamṛṣistvāsīdādisarge kasaṃbhavaḥ .
sakhā sārasvato jātaḥ supārśvo nāma vai vibhuḥ .. 94.3 ..
93.d:
विद्युत्प्रभ उवाच ।
देवि पूर्वमृषिस्त्वासीदादिसर्गे कसंभवः ।
सखा सारस्वतो जातः सुपार्श्वो नाम वै विभुः ॥ 94.3 ॥
93.m: Vidyutprabha said: / "O goddess, formerly in the primary creation there was a sage born from Ka; / a friend born from Sarasvatī, an all-pervading lord named Supārśva.

93.s:
tasyābhavanmahātejāḥ sindhudvīpaḥ pratāpavān .
sa hi tīvraṃ tapastepe māhiṣmatyāṃ purottame .. 94.4 ..
93.d:
तस्याभवन्महातेजाः सिन्धुद्वीपः प्रतापवान् ।
स हि तीव्रं तपस्तेपे माहिष्मत्यां पुरोत्तमे ॥ 94.4 ॥
93.m: He had a son of great splendour, the powerful Sindhudvīpa. / Indeed, he performed severe austerities in the excellent city of Māhiṣmatī.

93.s:
kurvatastu tapo ghoraṃ nirāhārasya śobhane .
ādyā tu vipracittestu sutā surasutopamā .
māhiṣmatīti vikhyātā rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi .. 94.5 ..
93.d:
कुर्वतस्तु तपो घोरं निराहारस्य शोभने ।
आद्या तु विप्रचित्तेस्तु सुता सुरसुतोपमा ।
माहिष्मतीति विख्याता रूपेणासदृशी भुवि ॥ 94.5 ॥
93.m: As he was performing terrible austerities without food, O fair one, / the eldest daughter of Vipracitti, resembling a daughter of the gods, / renowned as Māhiṣmatī, peerless in beauty on earth,

93.s:
sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā viharantī yadṛcchayā .
āgatā mandaradroṇīṃ tatrāpaśyat tapovanam .
munerambarasaṃjñasya vividhadrumamālinam .. 94.6 ..
93.d:
सा सखीभिः परिवृता विहरन्ती यदृच्छया ।
आगता मन्दरद्रोणीं तत्रापश्यत् तपोवनम् ।
मुनेरम्बरसंज्ञस्य विविधद्रुममालिनम् ॥ 94.6 ॥
93.m: wandering at will surrounded by her female companions, / came to the valley of Mandara. There she saw an ascetic hermitage / belonging to the sage named Ambara, abounding in various trees,

93.s:
latāgṛhaistu vividhairvakulairlakucaistathā .
candanaiḥ spandanaiḥ śālaiḥ saralairupaśobhitam .
vicitravanakhaṇḍaiśca bhūṣitaṃ tu mahātmanaḥ .. 94.7 ..
93.d:
लतागृहैस्तु विविधैर्वकुलैर्लकुचैस्तथा ।
चन्दनैः स्पन्दनैः शालैः सरलैरुपशोभितम् ।
विचित्रवनखण्डैश्च भूषितं तु महात्मनः ॥ 94.7 ॥
93.m: adorned with various arbours of creepers, with vakula and lakuca trees, / with sandalwood, spandana, śāla, and sarala trees, / and decorated with diverse groves belonging to that great-souled one.

93.s:
dṛṣṭvāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ sāsurī kanyakā śubham .
māhiṣmatī varārohā cintayāmāsa bhāminī .. 94.8 ..
93.d:
दृष्ट्वाश्रमपदं रम्यं सासुरी कन्यका शुभम् ।
माहिष्मती वरारोहा चिन्तयामास भामिनी ॥ 94.8 ॥
93.m: Seeing that charming and auspicious hermitage, that Asura maiden, / Māhiṣmatī of shapely hips, an impassioned lady, reflected:

93.s:
bhīṣayitvāhamenaṃ tu tāpasaṃ tvāśrame svayam .
tiṣṭhāmi krīḍatī sārdhaṃ sakhībhiḥ paramārcitā .. 94.9 ..
93.d:
भीषयित्वाहमेनं तु तापसं त्वाश्रमे स्वयम् ।
तिष्ठामि क्रीडती सार्धं सखीभिः परमार्चिता ॥ 94.9 ॥
93.m: "Having frightened this ascetic myself in the hermitage, / I shall stay, sporting with my female friends, highly honoured."

93.s:
evaṃ saṃcintya sā devī mahiṣī saṃbabhūva ha .
sakhībhiḥ saha viśveśi tīkṣṇaśrṛṅgāgradhāriṇī .. 94.10 ..
93.d:
एवं संचिन्त्य सा देवी महिषी संबभूव ह ।
सखीभिः सह विश्वेशि तीक्ष्णश्रृङ्गाग्रधारिणी ॥ 94.10 ॥
93.m: Having reflected thus, that goddess indeed became a buffalo-cow / along with her companions, O sovereign of the universe, bearing sharp horn-tips.

93.s:
tamṛṣiṃ bhīṣituṃ tābhiḥ saha gatvā varānanā .
asau bibhīṣitastābhistāṃ jñātvā jñānacakṣuṣā .
āsurīṃ krodhasaṃpannaḥ śaśāpa śubhalocanām .. 94.11 ..
93.d:
तमृषिं भीषितुं ताभिः सह गत्वा वरानना ।
असौ बिभीषितस्ताभिस्तां ज्ञात्वा ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
आसुरीं क्रोधसंपन्नः शशाप शुभलोचनाम् ॥ 94.11 ॥
93.m: The fair-faced woman went with them to frighten that sage. / When he was frightened by them, knowing her to be an Asura woman / through the eye of knowledge, he, filled with anger, cursed the bright-eyed maiden:

93.s:
yasmād bhīṣayase māṃ tvaṃ mahiṣīrūpadhāriṇī .
ato bhava mahiṣyeva pāpakarme śataṃ samāḥ .. 94.12 ..
93.d:
यस्माद् भीषयसे मां त्वं महिषीरूपधारिणी ।
अतो भव महिष्येव पापकर्मे शतं समाः ॥ 94.12 ॥
93.m: "Because you frighten me, assuming the form of a buffalo-cow, / therefore remain indeed as a buffalo-cow, evil-doer, for a hundred years!"

93.s:
evamuktā tataḥ sā tu sakhībhiḥ saha vepatī .
pādayornyapatat tasya śāpāntaṃ kuru jalpatī .. 94.13 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्ता ततः सा तु सखीभिः सह वेपती ।
पादयोर्न्यपतत् तस्य शापान्तं कुरु जल्पती ॥ 94.13 ॥
93.m: Addressed thus, trembling along with her female friends, / she fell at his feet, pleading: "Make an end to the curse!"

93.s:
tasyāstad vacanaṃ śrutvā sa muniḥ karuṇānvitaḥ .
śāpāntamakarot tasyā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha .. 94.14 ..
93.d:
तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा स मुनिः करुणान्वितः ।
शापान्तमकरोत् तस्या वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ॥ 94.14 ॥
93.m: Hearing that speech of hers, the sage, filled with compassion, / granted the end of the curse for her, and spoke these words:

93.s:
anenaiva svarūpeṇa putramekaṃ prasūya vai .
śāpānto bhavitā bhadre madvākyaṃ na mṛṣā bhavet .. 94.15 ..
93.d:
अनेनैव स्वरूपेण पुत्रमेकं प्रसूय वै ।
शापान्तो भविता भद्रे मद्वाक्यं न मृषा भवेत् ॥ 94.15 ॥
93.m: "By giving birth to a single son in this very form, / the end of the curse will come to be, auspicious lady; my word cannot be false."

93.s:
evamuktā gatā sā tu narmadātīramuttamam .
yatra tepe tapo ghoraṃ sindhudvīpo mahātapāḥ .. 94.16 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्ता गता सा तु नर्मदातीरमुत्तमम् ।
यत्र तेपे तपो घोरं सिन्धुद्वीपो महातपाः ॥ 94.16 ॥
93.m: Having been told thus, she went to the excellent bank of the Narmadā, / where Sindhudvīpa of great austerities was performing fierce asceticism.

93.s:
tatra cendumatī nāma daityakanyā'tirūpiṇī .
sā dṛṣṭā tena muninā vivastrā majjatī jale .. 94.17 ..
93.d:
तत्र चेन्दुमती नाम दैत्यकन्याऽतिरूपिणी ।
सा दृष्टा तेन मुनिना विवस्त्रा मज्जती जले ॥ 94.17 ॥
93.m: And there was an exceedingly beautiful Daitya maiden named Indumatī; / she was seen by that sage dipping naked in the water.

93.s:
caskanda sa muniḥ śukraṃ śilādroṇyāṃ mahātapāḥ .
tacca māhiṣmatī dṛṣṭvā divyagandhi sugandhi ca .
tataḥ sakhīruvācedaṃ pibāmīdaṃ jalaṃ śubham .. 94.18 ..
93.d:
चस्कन्द स मुनिः शुक्रं शिलाद्रोण्यां महातपाः ।
तच्च माहिष्मती दृष्ट्वा दिव्यगन्धि सुगन्धि च ।
ततः सखीरुवाचेदं पिबामीदं जलं शुभम् ॥ 94.18 ॥
93.m: That sage of great austerities discharged semen into a hollow rock trough; / and Māhiṣmatī, seeing that divine fragrance and sweet scent, / then spoke thus to her friends: "I shall drink this auspicious water."

93.s:
evamuktvā tu sā pītvā tacchukraṃ munisaṃbhavam .
prāptā garbhaṃ munerbījāt suṣāva ca tadā sato .. 94.19 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा पीत्वा तच्छुक्रं मुनिसंभवम् ।
प्राप्ता गर्भं मुनेर्बीजात् सुषाव च तदा सतो ॥ 94.19 ॥
93.m: Having spoken thus, she, having drunk that semen born of the sage, / conceived from the seed of the sage, and then brought forth [her young] from the virtuous one.

93.s:
tasyāḥ putro'bhavad dhīmān mahābalaparākramaḥ .
mahiṣeti smṛto nāmnā brahmavaṃśavivardhanaḥ .
sa tvāṃ varayate devi devasainyavimardanaḥ .. 94.20 ..
93.d:
तस्याः पुत्रोऽभवद् धीमान् महाबलपराक्रमः ।
महिषेति स्मृतो नाम्ना ब्रह्मवंशविवर्धनः ।
स त्वां वरयते देवि देवसैन्यविमर्दनः ॥ 94.20 ॥
93.m: Her son was intelligent, possessed of great strength and valour, / known by the name Mahiṣa, an increaser of the lineage of Brahmā. / He chooses you [in marriage], O Goddess, he the crusher of the army of the gods.

93.s:
sa surānapi jitvā''jau trailokyaṃ ca tavānaghe .
dāsyate devi suprotastava sarvaṃ mahāsuraḥ .
tasyātmopapradānena kuru devi mahat kṛtam .. 94.21 ..
93.d:
स सुरानपि जित्वा'ऽजौ त्रैलोक्यं च तवानघे ।
दास्यते देवि सुप्रोतस्तव सर्वं महासुरः ।
तस्यात्मोपप्रदानेन कुरु देवि महत् कृतम् ॥ 94.21 ॥
93.m: Having conquered even the gods in battle and the three worlds, O sinless one, / that great Asura, well-pleased, O Goddess, will give everything to you. / By offering your own self to him, O Goddess, do a great deed."

93.s:
evamuktā tadā devī tena dūtena śobhanā .
jahāsa paramā devī vākyaṃ novāca kiñcana .. 94.22 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा देवी तेन दूतेन शोभना ।
जहास परमा देवी वाक्यं नोवाच किञ्चन ॥ 94.22 ॥
93.m: Addressed thus by that messenger, the splendid, supreme Goddess / laughed and spoke not a word.

93.s:
tasyā hasantyā dūto'sau trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .
dadarśa kukṣau saṃbhrāntastatkṣaṇāt samapadyata .. 94.23 ..
93.d:
तस्या हसन्त्या दूतोऽसौ त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।
ददर्श कुक्षौ संभ्रान्तस्तत्क्षणात् समपद्यत ॥ 94.23 ॥
93.m: As she laughed, that messenger beheld the three worlds with the moving and unmoving / in her belly, and instantly became bewildered.

93.s:
tato devyāḥ pratīhārī jayā nāmātitejanā .
devyā hṛdi sthitaṃ vākyamuvāca tanumadhyamā .. 94.24 ..
93.d:
ततो देव्याः प्रतीहारी जया नामातितेजना ।
देव्या हृदि स्थितं वाक्यमुवाच तनुमध्यमा ॥ 94.24 ॥
93.m: Then the doorkeeper of the Goddess, slender-waisted, named Jayā, / possessing great brilliance, spoke words that were in the heart of the Goddess:

93.s:
jayā uvāca .
kanyārthī vadate yaddhi tattvayā samudīritam .
yadi nāma vrataṃ cāsyāḥ kaumāraṃ sārvakālikam .
api cānyāḥ kumāryo'tra santi devyāḥ padānugāḥ .. 94.25 ..
93.d:
जया उवाच ।
कन्यार्थी वदते यद्धि तत्त्वया समुदीरितम् ।
यदि नाम व्रतं चास्याः कौमारं सार्वकालिकम् ।
अपि चान्याः कुमार्योऽत्र सन्ति देव्याः पदानुगाः ॥ 94.25 ॥
93.m: Jayā said: / "Indeed, you have uttered what one seeking a maiden says. / But her vow is perpetual maidenhood; / moreover, there are other maidens here who follow the footsteps of the Goddess.

93.s:
tāsāmekā'pi no labhyā kimu devī svayaṃ śubhā .
yāhi dūta tvaran mā te kiñcidanyad bhaviṣyati .. 94.26 ..
93.d:
तासामेकाऽपि नो लभ्या किमु देवी स्वयं शुभा ।
याहि दूत त्वरन् मा ते किञ्चिदन्यद् भविष्यति ॥ 94.26 ॥
93.m: Not even one of them can be obtained, let alone the auspicious Goddess herself! / Go, messenger, make haste, lest something else happen to you."

93.s:
evamukto gato dūtastāvad vyomni mahāmuniḥ .
āyāto nāradastūrṇaṃ nṛtyannuccairmahātapāḥ .. 94.27 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्तो गतो दूतस्तावद् व्योम्नि महामुनिः ।
आयातो नारदस्तूर्णं नृत्यन्नुच्चैर्महातपाः ॥ 94.27 ॥
93.m: When the messenger, addressed thus, had departed, meanwhile in the sky the great sage / Nārada of great austerities arrived swiftly, dancing vigorously.

93.s:
diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti vadatastāṃ devīṃ śubhalocanām .
upaviṣṭo jagādātha āsane parame'rcitaḥ .. 94.28 ..
93.d:
दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्येति वदतस्तां देवीं शुभलोचनाम् ।
उपविष्टो जगादाथ आसने परमेऽर्चितः ॥ 94.28 ॥
93.m: Saying, "Hail! Hail!" to that bright-eyed Goddess, / he sat down on a supreme seat and, being honoured, then spoke.

93.s:
praṇamya devīṃ sarveśīmuvāca ca mahātapāḥ .
devi devairahaṃ prītaiḥ preṣito'smi tavāntikam .. 94.29 ..
93.d:
प्रणम्य देवीं सर्वेशीमुवाच च महातपाः ।
देवि देवैरहं प्रीतैः प्रेषितोऽस्मि तवान्तिकम् ॥ 94.29 ॥
93.m: Having bowed to the Goddess, the ruler of all, the one of great austerities said: / "O Goddess, I have been sent to your presence by the pleased gods.

93.s:
vijitā devi daityena mahiṣākhyena nirjarāḥ .
tvāṃ gṛhītuṃ prayatnaṃ sa kṛtavān devi daityarāṭ .. 94.30 ..
93.d:
विजिता देवि दैत्येन महिषाख्येन निर्जराः ।
त्वां गृहीतुं प्रयत्नं स कृतवान् देवि दैत्यराट् ॥ 94.30 ॥
93.m: The immortals, O Goddess, have been conquered by the Daitya named Mahiṣa; / he, the king of the Daityas, has made an effort to seize you, O Goddess.

93.s:
evamukto'smi devaistvāṃ bodhayāmi varānane .
sthirībhūtā mahādevi taṃ daityaṃ pratighātaya .. 94.31 ..
93.d:
एवमुक्तोऽस्मि देवैस्त्वां बोधयामि वरानने ।
स्थिरीभूता महादेवि तं दैत्यं प्रतिघातय ॥ 94.31 ॥
93.m: I was instructed thus by the gods, and I inform you, O fair-faced one: / becoming firm, O great Goddess, slay that Daitya!"

93.s:
uktvaivāntarhitaḥ sadyo nāradaḥ svecchayā yayau .
devī ca kanyāstāḥ sarvāḥ sannahyantāmuvāca ha .. 94.32 ..
93.d:
उक्त्वैवान्तर्हितः सद्यो नारदः स्वेच्छया ययौ ।
देवी च कन्यास्ताः सर्वाः सन्नह्यन्तामुवाच ह ॥ 94.32 ॥
93.m: Having spoken, Nārada instantly vanished and went away at his will; / and the Goddess spoke to all those maidens: "Arm yourselves!"

93.s:
tataḥ kanyā mahābhāgāḥ sarvāstā deviśāsanāt .
babhūvurghorarūpiṇyaḥ khaṅgacarmadhanurdharāḥ .
saṃgrāmahetoḥ saṃtasthurdaityavidhvaṃsanāya tāḥ .. 94.33 ..
93.d:
ततः कन्या महाभागाः सर्वास्ता देविशासनात् ।
बभूवुर्घोररूपिण्यः खङ्गचर्मधनुर्धराः ।
संग्रामहेतोः संतस्थुर्दैत्यविध्वंसनाय ताः ॥ 94.33 ॥
93.m: Then, by the order of the Goddess, all those illustrious maidens / assumed terrifying forms, bearing swords, shields, and bows; / they stood ready for battle in order to destroy the Daityas.

93.s:
tāvad daityabalaṃ sarvaṃ muktvā devacamūṃ drutam .
āyayau yatra tad devyāḥ saṃnaddhaṃ strībalaṃ mahat .. 94.34 ..
93.d:
तावद् दैत्यबलं सर्वं मुक्त्वा देवचमूं द्रुतम् ।
आययौ यत्र तद् देव्याः संनद्धं स्त्रीबलं महत् ॥ 94.34 ॥
93.m: Meanwhile the entire Daitya army, quickly abandoning the army of the gods, / came to where that great, well-equipped army of women belonging to the Goddess was.

93.s:
tatastā yuyudhuḥ kanyā dānavaiḥ saha darpitāḥ .
kṣaṇena tad balaṃ tābhiścaturaṅgaṃ nipātitam .. 94.35 ..
93.d:
ततस्ता युयुधुः कन्या दानवैः सह दर्पिताः ।
क्षणेन तद् बलं ताभिश्चतुरङ्गं निपातितम् ॥ 94.35 ॥
93.m: Then those proud maidens fought with the Dānavas; / in an instant that fourfold army was struck down by them.

93.s:
śirāṃsi tatra keṣāṃcicchinnāni patitāni ca .
apareṣāṃ vidāryoraḥ kravyādāḥ pānti śoṇitam .. 94.36 ..
93.d:
शिरांसि तत्र केषांचिच्छिन्नानि पतितानि च ।
अपरेषां विदार्योरः क्रव्यादाः पान्ति शोणितम् ॥ 94.36 ॥
93.m: The heads of some were severed there and fell; / flesh-eaters tore open the chests of others and drank their blood.

93.s:
anye kabandhabhūtāstu nanṛturdaityanāyakāḥ .
evaṃ kṣaṇena te sarve vidhvastāḥ pāpacetasaḥ .
apare vidrutāḥ sarve yatrāsau mahiṣāsuraḥ .. 94.37 ..
93.d:
अन्ये कबन्धभूतास्तु ननृतुर्दैत्यनायकाः ।
एवं क्षणेन ते सर्वे विध्वस्ताः पापचेतसः ।
अपरे विद्रुताः सर्वे यत्रासौ महिषासुरः ॥ 94.37 ॥
93.m: Other leaders of the Daityas danced as headless trunks. / In this way, in an instant, all those evil-minded ones were destroyed; / all the others fled to where that Mahiṣāsura was.

93.s:
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yathā daityabalaṃ mahat .
evaṃ tadākulaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣo vākyamabravīt .
senāpate kimetaddhi balaṃ bhagnaṃ mamāgrataḥ .. 94.38 ..
93.d:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं यथा दैत्यबलं महत् ।
एवं तदाकुलं दृष्ट्वा महिषो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
सेनापते किमेतद्धि बलं भग्नं ममाग्रतः ॥ 94.38 ॥
93.m: Then cries of woe arose as the great Daitya army [fled]. / Seeing it thus agitated, Mahiṣa spoke these words: / "O commander-in-chief, why has this army of mine broken before me?"

93.s:
tato yajñahanurnāmā daityo hastisvarūpavān .
uvāca bhagnametaddhi kumārībhiḥ samantataḥ .. 94.39 ..
93.d:
ततो यज्ञहनुर्नामा दैत्यो हस्तिस्वरूपवान् ।
उवाच भग्नमेतद्धि कुमारीभिः समन्ततः ॥ 94.39 ॥
93.m: Then a Daitya named Yajñahanu, having the form of an elephant, / said: "It has been broken on all sides by the young maidens."

93.s:
tato dudrāva mahiṣastāḥ kanyāḥ śubhalocanāḥ .
gadāmādāya tarasā kanyā dudrāva vegavān .. 94.40 ..
93.d:
ततो दुद्राव महिषस्ताः कन्याः शुभलोचनाः ।
गदामादाय तरसा कन्या दुद्राव वेगवान् ॥ 94.40 ॥
93.m: Then Mahiṣa rushed against those bright-eyed maidens; / seizing a mace, he swiftly and impetuously ran towards the maidens.

93.s:
yatra tiṣṭhati sā devī devagandharvapūjitā .
tatraiva so'suraḥ prāyād yatra devī vyavasthitā .
sā ca dṛṣṭvā tamāyāntaṃ viṃśaddhastā babhūva ha .. 94.41 ..
93.d:
यत्र तिष्ठति सा देवी देवगन्धर्वपूजिता ।
तत्रैव सोऽसुरः प्रायाद् यत्र देवी व्यवस्थिता ।
सा च दृष्ट्वा तमायान्तं विंशद्धस्ता बभूव ह ॥ 94.41 ॥
93.m: To where that Goddess, worshipped by gods and Gandharvas, was staying, / right there that Asura went, where the Goddess was standing. / And she, seeing him approach, became twenty-armed.

93.s:
dhanuḥ khaṅgaṃ tathā śaktiṃ śarān śūlaṃ gadāṃ tathā .
paraśuṃ ḍamaruṃ caiva tathā ghaṇṭāṃ viśālinīm .
śataghnīṃ mudgaraṃ ghoraṃ bhuśuṇḍīṃ kuntameva ca .. 94.42 ..
93.d:
धनुः खङ्गं तथा शक्तिं शरान् शूलं गदां तथा ।
परशुं डमरुं चैव तथा घण्टां विशालिनीम् ।
शतघ्नीं मुद्गरं घोरं भुशुण्डीं कुन्तमेव च ॥ 94.42 ॥
93.m: A bow, a sword, likewise a spear, arrows, a trident, and a mace; / an axe and a damaru, and likewise a large bell; / a śataghnī, a dreadful mallet, a bhuśuṇḍī, and a pike;

93.s:
musalaṃ ca tathā cakraṃ bhindipālaṃ tathaiva ca .
daṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva padmaṃ ceti ca viṃśatiḥ .. 94.43 ..
93.d:
मुसलं च तथा चक्रं भिन्दिपालं तथैव च ।
दण्डं पाशं ध्वजं चैव पद्मं चेति च विंशतिः ॥ 94.43 ॥
93.m: a pestle and a discus, and likewise a sling; / a staff, a noose, a banner, and a lotus—making twenty.

93.s:
bhūtvā viṃśabhujā devī siṃhamāsthāya daṃśitā .
sasmāra rudraṃ deveśaṃ raudraṃ saṃhārakāraṇam .. 94.44 ..
93.d:
भूत्वा विंशभुजा देवी सिंहमास्थाय दंशिता ।
सस्मार रुद्रं देवेशं रौद्रं संहारकारणम् ॥ 94.44 ॥
93.m: Becoming twenty-armed, mounted upon a lion, and clad in armour, the Goddess / remembered Rudra, the lord of gods, fierce and the cause of dissolution.

93.s:
tato vṛṣadhvajaḥ sākṣād rudrastatraiva āyayau .
tayā praṇamya vijñaptaḥ sarvān daityān jayāmyaham .. 94.45 ..
93.d:
ततो वृषध्वजः साक्षाद् रुद्रस्तत्रैव आययौ ।
तया प्रणम्य विज्ञप्तः सर्वान् दैत्यान् जयाम्यहम् ॥ 94.45 ॥
93.m: Then Rudra, whose emblem is a bull, came right there visibly. / Having bowed, she informed him: "I shall conquer all the Daityas,

93.s:
tvayi sannidhimātre tu devadeva sanātana .
evamuktvā'surān sarvān jigāya parameśvarī .. 94.46 ..
93.d:
त्वयि सन्निधिमात्रे तु देवदेव सनातन ।
एवमुक्त्वाऽसुरान् सर्वान् जिगाय परमेश्वरी ॥ 94.46 ॥
93.m: by your mere presence, O eternal God of gods." / Having spoken thus, the supreme sovereign conquered all the Asuras.

93.s:
muktavā tamekaṃ mahiṣaṃ śeṣaṃ hatvā tamabhyayāt .
yāvad devī tataḥ sā'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā so'pi dudruve .. 94.47 ..
93.d:
मुक्तवा तमेकं महिषं शेषं हत्वा तमभ्ययात् ।
यावद् देवी ततः साऽपि तां दृष्ट्वा सोऽपि दुद्रुवे ॥ 94.47 ॥
93.m: Leaving only that one Mahiṣa, having slain the rest, she approached him. / As soon as the Goddess [advanced], seeing her, he too fled.

93.s:
kvacid yudhyati daityendraḥ kvaciccaiva palāyati .
kvacit punarmṛdhaṃ cakre kvacit punarupāramat .. 94.48 ..
93.d:
क्वचिद् युध्यति दैत्येन्द्रः क्वचिच्चैव पलायति ।
क्वचित् पुनर्मृधं चक्रे क्वचित् पुनरुपारमत् ॥ 94.48 ॥
93.m: In some places the lord of Daityas fought, and in some places he fled; / in some places he offered battle again, and in some places he rested.

93.s:
evaṃ varṣahastrāṇi daśa tasya tayā saha .
divyāni vigatāni syuryudhyatastasya śobhane .
babhrāma sakalaṃ tvājau brahmāṇḍaṃ bhītamānasam .. 94.49 ..
93.d:
एवं वर्षहस्त्राणि दश तस्य तया सह ।
दिव्यानि विगतानि स्युर्युध्यतस्तस्य शोभने ।
बभ्राम सकलं त्वाजौ ब्रह्माण्डं भीतमानसम् ॥ 94.49 ॥
93.m: Thus ten thousand divine years passed for him with her / as he fought, O fair one; / the entire universe whirled about in battle, terrified in mind.

93.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā śataśrṛṅge mahāgirau .
padbhyāmākramya śūlena nihato daityasattamaḥ .. 94.50 ..
93.d:
ततः कालेन महता शतश्रृङ्गे महागिरौ ।
पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य शूलेन निहतो दैत्यसत्तमः ॥ 94.50 ॥
93.m: Then, after a great time, on the great mountain Śataśṛṅga, / the best of Daityas was trampled down with her feet and slain with her trident.

93.s:
śiraściccheda khaṅgena tatra cāntaḥsthitaḥ pumān .
nirgatya vigataḥ svargaṃ devyāḥ śastranipātanāt .. 94.51 ..
93.d:
शिरश्चिच्छेद खङ्गेन तत्र चान्तःस्थितः पुमान् ।
निर्गत्य विगतः स्वर्गं देव्याः शस्त्रनिपातनात् ॥ 94.51 ॥
93.m: She cut off his head with a sword; and the being dwelling within, / coming forth, went to heaven because of being struck down by the goddess’s weapon.

93.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve mahiṣaṃ vīkṣya nirjitam .
sabrahmakā stutiṃ cakrurdevyāstuṣṭena cetasā .. 94.52 ..
93.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे महिषं वीक्ष्य निर्जितम् ।
सब्रह्मका स्तुतिं चक्रुर्देव्यास्तुष्टेन चेतसा ॥ 94.52 ॥
93.m: Then all the hosts of gods, seeing Mahiṣa defeated, / led by Brahmā, praised the goddess with pleased minds.

93.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
namo devi mahābhāge gambhīre bhīmadarśane .
jayasthe sthitisiddhānte trinetre viśvatomukhi .. 94.53 ..
93.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
नमो देवि महाभागे गम्भीरे भीमदर्शने ।
जयस्थे स्थितिसिद्धान्ते त्रिनेत्रे विश्वतोमुखि ॥ 94.53 ॥
93.m: The gods said: / 'Salutations, O goddess, highly fortunate, profound, terrifying in appearance, / abiding in victory, foundational principle of existence, three-eyed, facing in all directions!

93.s:
vidyāvidye jaye yājye mahiṣāsuramardini .
sarvage sarvadeveśi viśvarūpiṇi vaiṣṇavi .. 94.54 ..
93.d:
विद्याविद्ये जये याज्ये महिषासुरमर्दिनि ।
सर्वगे सर्वदेवेशि विश्वरूपिणि वैष्णवि ॥ 94.54 ॥
93.m: Knowledge and ignorance, victory, worthy of sacrifice, slayer of the Mahiṣa demon, / all-pervading, sovereign of all gods, having the universe as your form, Vaiṣṇavī!

93.s:
vītaśoke dhruve devi padmapatraśubhekṣaṇe .
śuddhasattvavratasthe ca caṇḍarūpe vibhāvari .. 94.55 ..
93.d:
वीतशोके ध्रुवे देवि पद्मपत्रशुभेक्षणे ।
शुद्धसत्त्वव्रतस्थे च चण्डरूपे विभावरि ॥ 94.55 ॥
93.m: Free from sorrow, constant, O goddess, with eyes lovely as lotus petals, / abiding in the observance of pure sattva, of fierce form, night-bright one!

93.s:
ṛddhisiddhiprade devi vidye'vidye'mṛte śive .
śāṃkarī vaiṣṇavī brāhmī sarvadevanamaskṛte .. 94.56 ..
93.d:
ऋद्धिसिद्धिप्रदे देवि विद्येऽविद्येऽमृते शिवे ।
शांकरी वैष्णवी ब्राह्मी सर्वदेवनमस्कृते ॥ 94.56 ॥
93.m: Bestower of prosperity and siddhi, O goddess, knowledge, ignorance, immortal, auspicious, / Śāṅkarī, Vaiṣṇavī, Brāhmī, worshipped by all the gods!

93.s:
ghaṇṭāhaste triśūlāstre mahāmahiṣamardini .
ugrarūpe virūpākṣi mahāmāye'mṛtastrave .. 94.57 ..
93.d:
घण्टाहस्ते त्रिशूलास्त्रे महामहिषमर्दिनि ।
उग्ररूपे विरूपाक्षि महामायेऽमृतस्त्रवे ॥ 94.57 ॥
93.m: Holding a bell in your hand, armed with the trident, crusher of the great Mahiṣa, / of terrible form, odd-eyed, Mahāmāyā, streaming with nectar!

93.s:
sarvasattvahite devi sarvasattvamaye dhruve .
vidyāpurāṇaśilpānāṃ jananī bhūtadhāriṇī .. 94.58 ..
93.d:
सर्वसत्त्वहिते देवि सर्वसत्त्वमये ध्रुवे ।
विद्यापुराणशिल्पानां जननी भूतधारिणी ॥ 94.58 ॥
93.m: Benefactress of all beings, O goddess, composed of all beings, firm, / mother of the branches of knowledge, the Purāṇas, and the arts, sustainer of beings!

93.s:
sarvadevarahasyānāṃ sarvasattvavatāṃ śubhe .
tvameva śaraṇaṃ devi vidye'vidye śriye'mbike .
virūpākṣi tathā kṣānti kṣobhitāntarjale'vile .. 94.59 ..
93.d:
सर्वदेवरहस्यानां सर्वसत्त्ववतां शुभे ।
त्वमेव शरणं देवि विद्येऽविद्ये श्रियेऽम्बिके ।
विरूपाक्षि तथा क्षान्ति क्षोभितान्तर्जलेऽविले ॥ 94.59 ॥
93.m: Secret of all the gods, auspicious to all who possess sattva, / you alone are refuge, O goddess, knowledge, ignorance, fortune, Ambikā, / odd-eyed, likewise patience, agitating the water within, undisturbed!

93.s:
namo'stu te mahādevi namo'stu parameśvari .
namaste sarvadevānāṃ bhāvanitye'kṣaye'vyaye .. 94.60 ..
93.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते महादेवि नमोऽस्तु परमेश्वरि ।
नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां भावनित्येऽक्षयेऽव्यये ॥ 94.60 ॥
93.m: Salutations to you, Mahādevī! Salutations, Supreme Sovereign! / Salutations to you, the eternal thought of all the gods, imperishable, immutable!

93.s:
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapadyante ye devi parameśvari .
na teṣāṃ jāyate kiñcidaśubhaṃ raṇasaṅkaṭe .. 94.61 ..
93.d:
शरणं त्वां प्रपद्यन्ते ये देवि परमेश्वरि ।
न तेषां जायते किञ्चिदशुभं रणसङ्कटे ॥ 94.61 ॥
93.m: Those who take refuge in you, O goddess, Supreme Sovereign, / no misfortune whatever befalls them in the crisis of battle.

93.s:
yaśca vyāghrabhaye ghore caurarājabhaye tathā .
stabavamenaṃ sadā devi paṭhiṣyati yatātmavān .. 94.62 ..
93.d:
यश्च व्याघ्रभये घोरे चौरराजभये तथा ।
स्तबवमेनं सदा देवि पठिष्यति यतात्मवान् ॥ 94.62 ॥
93.m: And whoever, in dread fear of tigers, or likewise in fear of thieves and kings, / shall constantly recite this praise, O goddess, self-controlled,

93.s:
nigaḍastho'pi yo devi tvāṃ smariṣyati mānavaḥ .
so'pi bandhairvimuktaste susukhaṃ vasate sukhī .. 94.63 ..
93.d:
निगडस्थोऽपि यो देवि त्वां स्मरिष्यति मानवः ।
सोऽपि बन्धैर्विमुक्तस्ते सुसुखं वसते सुखी ॥ 94.63 ॥
93.m: or whatever mortal, even when bound in chains, O goddess, shall remember you, / he too is freed from bonds and lives very comfortably, happy.'

93.s:
śrīvarāha uvāca .
evaṃ stutā tadā devī devaiḥ praṇatipūrvakam .
uvāca devān suśroṇī vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam .. 94.64 ..
93.d:
श्रीवराह उवाच ।
एवं स्तुता तदा देवी देवैः प्रणतिपूर्वकम् ।
उवाच देवान् सुश्रोणी वृणुध्वं वरमुत्तमम् ॥ 94.64 ॥
93.m: The holy Varāha said: / Having been thus praised then by the gods preceded by bows, / the goddess of fair hips spoke to the gods: 'Choose an excellent boon!'

93.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
devi stotramidaṃ ye hi paṭhiṣyanti tavānaghe .
sarvakāmasamāpannān kuru devi sa no varaḥ .. 94.65 ..
93.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
देवि स्तोत्रमिदं ये हि पठिष्यन्ति तवानघे ।
सर्वकामसमापन्नान् कुरु देवि स नो वरः ॥ 94.65 ॥
93.m: The gods said: / 'O goddess, those who recite this praise of yours, O sinless one, / make them endowed with all desires, O goddess; that is our boon.'

93.s:
evamastviti tān devānuktvā devī parā'parā .
visasarja tato devān svayaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitā .. 94.66 ..
93.d:
एवमस्त्विति तान् देवानुक्त्वा देवी पराऽपरा ।
विससर्ज ततो देवान् स्वयं तत्रैव संस्थिता ॥ 94.66 ॥
93.m: Having said to those gods, 'So be it,' the supreme and non-supreme goddess / then dismissed the gods and remained right there herself.

93.s:
etad dvitīyaṃ yo janma veda devyā dharādhare .
sa vītaśoko virajāḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam .. 94.67 ..
93.d:
एतद् द्वितीयं यो जन्म वेद देव्या धराधरे ।
स वीतशोको विरजाः पदं गच्छत्यनामयम् ॥ 94.67 ॥
93.m: Whoever knows this second birth of the goddess, O Earth, / freed from sorrow and cleansed of passion, goes to the ailment-free abode.

93.s: .. iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 94 ..
93.d: ॥ इति श्रीवराहपुराणे भगवच्छास्त्रे चतुर्नवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 94 ॥
93.m: Thus ends the ninety-fourth chapter in the holy Varāhapurāṇa, the divine scripture.

94.s:
śrīvarāha uvāca .
yā sā nīlagiriṃ yātā tapase dhṛtamānasā .
raudrī tamodbhavā śaktistasyāḥ śrṛṇu dhare vratam .. 95.1 ..
94.d:
श्रीवराह उवाच ।
या सा नीलगिरिं याता तपसे धृतमानसा ।
रौद्री तमोद्भवा शक्तिस्तस्याः श्रृणु धरे व्रतम् ॥ 95.1 ॥
94.m: The holy Varāha said: / She who went to the Blue Mountain, her mind resolved upon austerity, / Raudrī, the power arisen from tamas—hear her observance, O Earth!

94.s:
tapaḥ kṛtvā ciraṃ kālaṃ pālayāmyakhilaṃ jagat .
evamuddiśya pañcāgniṃ sādhayāmāsa bhāminī .. 95.2 ..
94.d:
तपः कृत्वा चिरं कालं पालयाम्यखिलं जगत् ।
एवमुद्दिश्य पञ्चाग्निं साधयामास भामिनी ॥ 95.2 ॥
94.m: Thinking: 'Having performed austerity for a long time, I will protect the entire universe,' / with this purpose the passionate woman undertook the five-fire penance.

94.s:
tasyāḥ kālāntare devyāstapantyāstapa uttamam .
rururnāma mahātejā brahmadattavaro'suraḥ .. 95.3 ..
94.d:
तस्याः कालान्तरे देव्यास्तपन्त्यास्तप उत्तमम् ।
रुरुर्नाम महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तवरोऽसुरः ॥ 95.3 ॥
94.m: After a course of time, as that goddess was performing excellent austerity, / there was an Asura named Ruru, of great splendor, who had been granted boons by Brahmā.

94.s:
samudramadhye ratnāḍhyaṃ puramasti mahāvanam .
tatra rājā sa daityendraḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 95.4 ..
94.d:
समुद्रमध्ये रत्नाढ्यं पुरमस्ति महावनम् ।
तत्र राजा स दैत्येन्द्रः सर्वदेवभयंकरः ॥ 95.4 ॥
94.m: In the midst of the ocean there is a great forest-city rich in jewels; / there he was king, a lord of Daityas, terrifying to all the gods,

94.s:
anekaśatasāhastrakoṭikoṭiśatottaraiḥ .
asurairanvitaḥ śrīmān dvitīyo namuciryathā .. 95.5 ..
94.d:
अनेकशतसाहस्त्रकोटिकोटिशतोत्तरैः ।
असुरैरन्वितः श्रीमान् द्वितीयो नमुचिर्यथा ॥ 95.5 ॥
94.m: accompanied by many hundreds, thousands, and hundreds of crores of Asuras, / glorious, like a second Namuci.

94.s:
kālena mahatā cāsau lokapālapurāṇyatha .
jigīṣuḥ sainyasaṃvīto devairbhayamarocayat .. 95.6 ..
94.d:
कालेन महता चासौ लोकपालपुराण्यथ ।
जिगीषुः सैन्यसंवीतो देवैर्भयमरोचयत् ॥ 95.6 ॥
94.m: And after a long time, wishing to conquer / the cities of the guardians of the worlds, surrounded by his army, he struck fear into the gods.

94.s:
uttiṣṭhatastasya mahāsurasya
samudratoyaṃ vavṛdhe'timātram .
anekanakragrahamīnajuṣṭa -
māplāvayat parvatasānudeśān .. 95.7 ..
94.d:
उत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य महासुरस्य
समुद्रतोयं ववृधेऽतिमात्रम् ।
अनेकनक्रग्रहमीनजुष्ट -
माप्लावयत् पर्वतसानुदेशान् ॥ 95.7 ॥
94.m: As that great Asura rose up, / the ocean water swelled exceedingly; / filled with many crocodiles, sea-monsters, and fish, / it inundated the regions of the mountain slopes.

94.s:
antaḥ sthitānekasurārisaṃghaṃ
vicitracarmāyudhacitraśobham .
bhīmaṃ balaṃ balinaṃ cāruyodhaṃ
viniryayau sindhujalād viśālam .. 95.8 ..
94.d:
अन्तः स्थितानेकसुरारिसंघं
विचित्रचर्मायुधचित्रशोभम् ।
भीमं बलं बलिनं चारुयोधं
विनिर्ययौ सिन्धुजलाद् विशालम् ॥ 95.8 ॥
94.m: Bearing within it many hosts of the enemies of the gods, / splendid with diverse armor and wondrous weapons, / the terrifying, powerful force with handsome warriors, / vast, marched forth from the ocean waters.

94.s:
tatra dvipā daityavarairupetā
samānaghaṇṭāsusamūhayuktāḥ .
viniryayuḥ svākṛtibhīṣaṇāni
samantamuccaiḥ khalu darśayantaḥ .. 95.9 ..
94.d:
तत्र द्विपा दैत्यवरैरुपेता
समानघण्टासुसमूहयुक्ताः ।
विनिर्ययुः स्वाकृतिभीषणानि
समन्तमुच्चैः खलु दर्शयन्तः ॥ 95.9 ॥
94.m: There elephants mounted by choice Daityas, / equipped with matching bells in well-ordered clusters, / marched forth, truly displaying all around / and on high their formidable forms.

94.s:
aśvāstathā kāñcanapīḍanaddhā
rohītamatsyaiḥ samatāṃ jalāntaḥ .
vyavasthitāste samameva tūrṇaṃ
viniryayuḥ lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśaśca .. 95.10 ..
94.d:
अश्वास्तथा काञ्चनपीडनद्धा
रोहीतमत्स्यैः समतां जलान्तः ।
व्यवस्थितास्ते सममेव तूर्णं
विनिर्ययुः लक्षशः कोटिशश्च ॥ 95.10 ॥
94.m: Likewise horses fastened with golden trappings, / matching the rohīta fish within the water, / situated together, marched forth swiftly / in their hundreds of thousands and crores.

94.s:
rathā ravisyandanatulyavegāḥ
sucakradaṇḍākṣatriveṇuyuktāḥ .
suśastrayantrāḥ paripīḍitāṅgā -
ścalatpatākāstvaritaṃ viśaṅkāḥ .. 95.11 ..
94.d:
रथा रविस्यन्दनतुल्यवेगाः
सुचक्रदण्डाक्षत्रिवेणुयुक्ताः ।
सुशस्त्रयन्त्राः परिपीडिताङ्गा -
श्चलत्पताकास्त्वरितं विशङ्काः ॥ 95.11 ॥
94.m: Chariots with speed equal to the chariot of the sun, / furnished with fine wheels, poles, axles, and poles of three rods, / having good weapon-engines, their frames tightly bound, / with fluttering banners, [marched] swiftly, devoid of fear.

94.s:
tathaiva yodhāḥ sthagitetaretarā -
stitīrṣavaḥ pravarāstūrṇapāṇayaḥ .
raṇe raṇe labdhajayāḥ prahāriṇo
virejuruccairasurānugā bhṛśam .. 95.12 ..
94.d:
तथैव योधाः स्थगितेतरेतरा -
स्तितीर्षवः प्रवरास्तूर्णपाणयः ।
रणे रणे लब्धजयाः प्रहारिणो
विरेजुरुच्चैरसुरानुगा भृशम् ॥ 95.12 ॥
94.m: Just so the warriors, standing close to one another, / eager to cross over, excellent, swift-handed, / having won victory in battle after battle, striking hard, / shone brightly on high, the followers of the Asura.

94.s:
deveṣu caiva bhagneṣu vinirgatya jalāt tataḥ .
caturaṅgabalopetaḥ prāyādindrapuraṃ prati .. 95.13 ..
94.d:
देवेषु चैव भग्नेषु विनिर्गत्य जलात् ततः ।
चतुरङ्गबलोपेतः प्रायादिन्द्रपुरं प्रति ॥ 95.13 ॥
94.m: And when the gods were routed, having come forth from the water, / endowed with his fourfold army, he set out towards the city of Indra.

94.s:
yuyodha ca sūraiḥ sārddhaṃ rururdaityapatistathā .
mudgarairmuśalaiḥ śūlaiḥ śarairdaṇḍāyudhaistathā .
jaghnurdaityāḥ surān saṃkhye surāścaiva tathā'surān .. 95.14 ..
94.d:
युयोध च सूरैः सार्द्धं रुरुर्दैत्यपतिस्तथा ।
मुद्गरैर्मुशलैः शूलैः शरैर्दण्डायुधैस्तथा ।
जघ्नुर्दैत्याः सुरान् संख्ये सुराश्चैव तथाऽसुरान् ॥ 95.14 ॥
94.m: And Ruru, the lord of Daityas, fought with the gods; / with mallets, clubs, spears, arrows, and staff-weapons, / the Daityas struck the gods in battle, and the gods likewise struck the Asuras.

94.s:
evaṃ kṣaṇamatho yuddhaṃ tadā devāḥ savāsavāḥ .
asurairnirjitāḥ sadyo dudruvurvimukhā bhṛśam .. 95.15 ..
94.d:
एवं क्षणमथो युद्धं तदा देवाः सवासवाः ।
असुरैर्निर्जिताः सद्यो दुद्रुवुर्विमुखा भृशम् ॥ 95.15 ॥
94.m: Thus for a moment the battle raged; then the gods with Indra, / defeated at once by the Asuras, turned their backs and fled in haste.

94.s:
deveṣu caiva bhagneṣu vidruteṣu viśeṣataḥ .
asuraḥ sarvadevānāmanvadhāvata vīryavān .. 95.16 ..
94.d:
देवेषु चैव भग्नेषु विद्रुतेषु विशेषतः ।
असुरः सर्वदेवानामन्वधावत वीर्यवान् ॥ 95.16 ॥
94.m: And when the gods were broken and in flight in particular, / the mighty Asura pursued all the gods.

94.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve dravanto bhayavihvalāḥ .
nīlaṃ girivaraṃ jagmuryatra devī vyavasthitā .. 95.17 ..
94.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे द्रवन्तो भयविह्वलाः ।
नीलं गिरिवरं जग्मुर्यत्र देवी व्यवस्थिता ॥ 95.17 ॥
94.m: Then all the hosts of gods, fleeing, distraught with fear, / went to the excellent mountain Nīla, where the goddess was situated.

94.s:
audrī taporatā devī tāmasī śaktiruttamā .
saṃhārakāriṇī devī kālarātrīti tāṃ viduḥ .. 95.18 ..
94.d:
औद्री तपोरता देवी तामसी शक्तिरुत्तमा ।
संहारकारिणी देवी कालरात्रीति तां विदुः ॥ 95.18 ॥
94.m: [She was] Raudrī, devoted to austerity, the supreme tāmasic power, / the goddess who causes destruction; they know her as Kālarātrī.

94.s:
sā dṛṣṭvā tān tadā devān bhayatrastān vicetasaḥ .
mā bhaiṣṭetyuccakairdevī tānuvāca surottamān .. 95.19 ..
94.d:
सा दृष्ट्वा तान् तदा देवान् भयत्रस्तान् विचेतसः ।
मा भैष्टेत्युच्चकैर्देवी तानुवाच सुरोत्तमान् ॥ 95.19 ॥
94.m: Seeing those gods then, terrified by fear and bewildered, / the goddess spoke aloud to those best of gods: 'Do not fear!'

94.s:
devyuvāca .
kimiyaṃ vyākulā devā gatirva upalakṣyate .
kathayadhvaṃ drutaṃ devāḥ sarvathā bhayakāraṇam .. 95.20 ..
94.d:
देव्युवाच ।
किमियं व्याकुला देवा गतिर्व उपलक्ष्यते ।
कथयध्वं द्रुतं देवाः सर्वथा भयकारणम् ॥ 95.20 ॥
94.m:
The Goddess said:
"Why is this agitated gait observed in you, O gods?
Tell [me] quickly, O gods, the entire cause of your fear."

94.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
ayamāyāti daityendro rururbhīmaparākramaḥ .
etasya bhītān rakṣasva tvaṃ devān parameśvari .. 95.21 ..
94.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
अयमायाति दैत्येन्द्रो रुरुर्भीमपराक्रमः ।
एतस्य भीतान् रक्षस्व त्वं देवान् परमेश्वरि ॥ 95.21 ॥
94.m:
The gods said:
"This lord of Daityas, Ruru of terrifying prowess, is approaching.
Protect the gods who are afraid of him, O supreme sovereign!"

94.s:
evamuktā tadā devairdevī bhīmaparākramā .
jahāsa parayā prītyā devānāṃ purataḥ śubhā .. 95.22 ..
94.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा देवैर्देवी भीमपराक्रमा ।
जहास परया प्रीत्या देवानां पुरतः शुभा ॥ 95.22 ॥
94.m:
Having been spoken to in this manner by the gods, the auspicious Goddess of terrifying prowess
laughed with extreme delight before the gods.

94.s:
tasyā hasantyā vaktrāt tu bahvyo devyo viniryayuḥ .
yābhirviśvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ vikṛtābhiranekaśaḥ .. 95.23 ..
94.d:
तस्या हसन्त्या वक्त्रात् तु बह्व्यो देव्यो विनिर्ययुः ।
याभिर्विश्वमिदं व्याप्तं विकृताभिरनेकशः ॥ 95.23 ॥
94.m:
From the mouth of her, as she was laughing, numerous goddesses came forth,
by whom, misshapen in various forms, this universe was pervaded.

94.s:
pāśāṅkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāḥ pīnapayodharāḥ .
sarvāḥ śūladharā bhīmāḥ sarvāścāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ .. 95.24 ..
94.d:
पाशाङ्कुशधराः सर्वाः सर्वाः पीनपयोधराः ।
सर्वाः शूलधरा भीमाः सर्वाश्चापधराः शुभाः ॥ 95.24 ॥
94.m:
All holding nooses and goads, all with swelling breasts,
all bearing tridents, terrifying, all bearing bows, auspicious.

94.s:
tāḥ sarvāḥ koṭiśo devyastāṃ devīṃ veṣṭya saṃsthitāḥ .
yuyudhudarnivaiḥ sārddhaṃ baddhatūṇā mahābalāḥ .
kṣaṇena dānavabalaṃ tatsarvaṃ nihataṃ tu taiḥ .. 95.25 ..
94.d:
ताः सर्वाः कोटिशो देव्यस्तां देवीं वेष्ट्य संस्थिताः ।
युयुधुदर्निवैः सार्द्धं बद्धतूणा महाबलाः ।
क्षणेन दानवबलं तत्सर्वं निहतं तु तैः ॥ 95.25 ॥

94.s:
devāśca sarve saṃyattā yuyudhurdānavaṃ balam .
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathāśvinau .
sarve śastrāṇi saṃgṛhya yuyudhurdānavaṃ balam .. 95.26 ..
94.d:
देवाश्च सर्वे संयत्ता युयुधुर्दानवं बलम् ।
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवास्तथाश्विनौ ।
सर्वे शस्त्राणि संगृह्य युयुधुर्दानवं बलम् ॥ 95.26 ॥
94.m:
And all the gods prepared and fought the army of the Dānavas:
the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Viśvedevas, and the two Aśvins,
all taking up weapons, fought the army of the Dānavas.

94.s:
kālarātryā balaṃ yacca yacca devabalaṃ mahat .
tatsarvaṃ dānavabalamanayad yamasādanam .. 95.27 ..
94.d:
कालरात्र्या बलं यच्च यच्च देवबलं महत् ।
तत्सर्वं दानवबलमनयद् यमसादनम् ॥ 95.27 ॥
94.m:
The army belonging to Kālarātrī and the great army belonging to the gods—
all of that dispatched the Dānava army to the abode of Yama.

94.s:
eka eva mahādaityo rurustasthau mahāmṛdhe .
sa ca māyāṃ mahāraudrīṃ rauravīṃ visasarja ha .. 95.28 ..
94.d:
एक एव महादैत्यो रुरुस्तस्थौ महामृधे ।
स च मायां महारौद्रीं रौरवीं विससर्ज ह ॥ 95.28 ॥
94.m:
Only the great Daitya Ruru stood alone in the great battle,
and he discharged a dreadful, terrifying creative illusion.

94.s:
sā māyā vavṛdhe bhīmā sarvadevapramohinī .
tayā tu mohitā devāḥ sadyo nidrāṃ tu bhejire .. 95.29 ..
94.d:
सा माया ववृधे भीमा सर्वदेवप्रमोहिनी ।
तया तु मोहिता देवाः सद्यो निद्रां तु भेजिरे ॥ 95.29 ॥
94.m:
That dreadful creative illusion expanded, confounding all the gods.
Deluded by it, the gods immediately fell into sleep.

94.s:
devī ca triśikhenājau taṃ daityaṃ samatāḍyat .
tayā tu tāḍitāntasya daityasya śubhalocane .
carmamuṇḍe ubhe samyak pṛthagbhūte babhūvatuḥ .. 95.30 ..
94.d:
देवी च त्रिशिखेनाजौ तं दैत्यं समताड्यत् ।
तया तु ताडितान्तस्य दैत्यस्य शुभलोचने ।
चर्ममुण्डे उभे सम्यक् पृथग्भूते बभूवतुः ॥ 95.30 ॥
94.m:
And the Goddess struck that Daitya in battle with a three-pronged spear.
When he was struck by her within, O fair-eyed one,
both the skin and the head of the Daitya became completely separated.

94.s:
rurostu dānavendrasya carmamuṇḍe kṣaṇād yataḥ .
apahṛtyāharad devī cāmuṇḍā tena sābhavat .. 95.31 ..
94.d:
रुरोस्तु दानवेन्द्रस्य चर्ममुण्डे क्षणाद् यतः ।
अपहृत्याहरद् देवी चामुण्डा तेन साभवत् ॥ 95.31 ॥
94.m:
Because the Goddess carried off the skin and the head (carma-muṇḍe)
of Ruru, the lord of Dānavas, in an instant, she became known as Cāmuṇḍā.

94.s:
sarvabhūtamahāraudrī yā devī parameśvarī .
saṃhāriṇī tu yā caiva kālarātriḥ prakīrtitā .. 95.32 ..
94.d:
सर्वभूतमहारौद्री या देवी परमेश्वरी ।
संहारिणी तु या चैव कालरात्रिः प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 95.32 ॥
94.m:
The Goddess, the supreme sovereign, who is greatly terrible to all beings,
and who is the destroyer, is known as Kālarātrī.

94.s:
tasyā hyanucarā devyo yā hyasaṃkhyātakoṭayaḥ .
tāstāṃ devīṃ mahābhāgāṃ parivārya vyavasthitāḥ .. 95.33 ..
94.d:
तस्या ह्यनुचरा देव्यो या ह्यसंख्यातकोटयः ।
तास्तां देवीं महाभागां परिवार्य व्यवस्थिताः ॥ 95.33 ॥
94.m:
Her attendant goddesses, who number countless crores,
stood surrounding that exalted Goddess.

94.s:
yā kyāmāsuravyagrāstāstāṃ devīṃ bubhukṣitāḥ .
bubhukṣitā vayaṃ devi dehi no bhojanaṃ śubhe .. 95.34 ..
94.d:
या क्यामासुरव्यग्रास्तास्तां देवीं बुभुक्षिताः ।
बुभुक्षिता वयं देवि देहि नो भोजनं शुभे ॥ 95.34 ॥
94.m:
They, hungry, addressed that Goddess without hesitation:
"We are hungry, O Goddess; give us food, O auspicious one!"

94.s:
evamuktā tadā devī dadhyau tāsāṃ tu bhojanam .
na cādhyagacchacca yadā tāsāṃ bhojanamantikāt .. 95.35 ..
94.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा देवी दध्यौ तासां तु भोजनम् ।
न चाध्यगच्छच्च यदा तासां भोजनमन्तिकात् ॥ 95.35 ॥
94.m:
Addressed thus, the Goddess then contemplated food for them;
and when she found no food for them near at hand,

94.s:
tato dadhyau mahādevaṃ rudraṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum .
so'pi dhyānāt samuttasthau paramātmā trilocanaḥ .. 95.36 ..
94.d:
ततो दध्यौ महादेवं रुद्रं पशुपतिं विभुम् ।
सोऽपि ध्यानात् समुत्तस्थौ परमात्मा त्रिलोचनः ॥ 95.36 ॥
94.m:
she then meditated upon Mahādeva, the all-pervading Rudra, Paśupati.
He too arose from meditation, the supreme self with three eyes.

94.s:
uvāca ca drutaṃ devīṃ kiṃ te kāryaṃ vivakṣitam .
brūhi devi varārohe yat te manasi varttate .. 95.37 ..
94.d:
उवाच च द्रुतं देवीं किं ते कार्यं विवक्षितम् ।
ब्रूहि देवि वरारोहे यत् ते मनसि वर्त्तते ॥ 95.37 ॥
94.m:
And he quickly said to the Goddess: "What is the matter you wish to speak of?
Tell [me], O Goddess, O woman of beautiful limbs, what is in your mind."

94.s:
devyuvāca .
bhakṣyārthamāsāṃ deveśa kiñcid dātumihārhasi .
balātkurvanti māmetā bhakṣārthinyo mahābalāḥ .
anyathā māmapi balād bhakṣayiṣyanti māṃ prabho .. 95.38 ..
94.d:
देव्युवाच ।
भक्ष्यार्थमासां देवेश किञ्चिद् दातुमिहार्हसि ।
बलात्कुर्वन्ति मामेता भक्षार्थिन्यो महाबलाः ।
अन्यथा मामपि बलाद् भक्षयिष्यन्ति मां प्रभो ॥ 95.38 ॥
94.m:
The Goddess said:
"O Lord of the gods, you ought to grant something here for their nourishment.
Desiring food, these exceedingly powerful [goddesses] are pressing me forcefully;
otherwise, O Lord, they will forcibly devour even me!"

94.s:
rudra uvāca .
etāsāṃ śrṛṇu deveśi bhakṣamekaṃ mayodyatam .
kathyamānaṃ varārohe kālarātri mahāprabhe .. 95.39 ..
94.d:
रुद्र उवाच ।
एतासां श्रृणु देवेशि भक्षमेकं मयोद्यतम् ।
कथ्यमानं वरारोहे कालरात्रि महाप्रभे ॥ 95.39 ॥
94.m:
Rudra said:
"O sovereign of the gods, listen to the sole nourishment for them provided by me,
which is being spoken, O woman of beautiful limbs, O Kālarātrī of great splendor!

94.s:
yā strī sagarbhā deveśi anyastrīparidhānakam .
paridhatte spṛśeccāpi puruṣasya viśeṣataḥ .. 95.40 ..
94.d:
या स्त्री सगर्भा देवेशि अन्यस्त्रीपरिधानकम् ।
परिधत्ते स्पृशेच्चापि पुरुषस्य विशेषतः ॥ 95.40 ॥
94.m:
Whatever pregnant woman, O sovereign of the gods, puts on the garment of another woman,
or even touches it, particularly that of a man,

94.s:
sa bhāgo'stu mahābhāge kāsāñcit pṛthivītale .
anyāśchidreṣu bālāni gṛhītvā tatra vai balim .
labdhvā tiṣṭhantu suprītā api varṣaśatānyapi .. 95.41 ..
94.d:
स भागोऽस्तु महाभागे कासाञ्चित् पृथिवीतले ।
अन्याश्छिद्रेषु बालानि गृहीत्वा तत्र वै बलिम् ।
लब्ध्वा तिष्ठन्तु सुप्रीता अपि वर्षशतान्यपि ॥ 95.41 ॥
94.m:
let that be the portion of some [of them] on the surface of the earth, O exalted one!
Let others, seizing children during vulnerabilities and obtaining an offering there,
remain well-pleased even for hundreds of years.

94.s:
anyāḥ sūtigṛhe chidraṃ gṛhṇīyustatra pūjitāḥ .
nivasiṣyanti deveśi tathānyā jātahārikāḥ .. 95.42 ..
94.d:
अन्याः सूतिगृहे छिद्रं गृह्णीयुस्तत्र पूजिताः ।
निवसिष्यन्ति देवेशि तथान्या जातहारिकाः ॥ 95.42 ॥
94.m:
Let others seize vulnerability in the lying-in room; worshipped there,
they will reside, O sovereign of the gods, as will others who carry away the newborn.

94.s:
gṛhe kṣetre taḍāgeṣu vāpyudyāneṣu caiva hi .
anyacittā rudantyo yāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ .
tāsāṃ śarīrāṇyāviśya kāścittṛptimavāpsyatha .. 95.43 ..
94.d:
गृहे क्षेत्रे तडागेषु वाप्युद्यानेषु चैव हि ।
अन्यचित्ता रुदन्त्यो याः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति नित्यशः ।
तासां शरीराण्याविश्य काश्चित्तृप्तिमवाप्स्यथ ॥ 95.43 ॥
94.m:
In a house, a field, in tanks, and in wells and gardens,
whatever women continually remain distracted in mind and weeping,
entering their bodies, some [of you] shall find satisfaction."

94.s:
evamuktvā tadā devīṃ svayaṃ rudraḥ pratāpavān .
dṛṣṭvā ruruṃ ca sabalamasurendraṃ nipātitam .
stutiṃ cakāra bhagavān svayaṃ devastrilocanaḥ .. 95.44 ..
94.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवीं स्वयं रुद्रः प्रतापवान् ।
दृष्ट्वा रुरुं च सबलमसुरेन्द्रं निपातितम् ।
स्तुतिं चकार भगवान् स्वयं देवस्त्रिलोचनः ॥ 95.44 ॥
94.m:
Having spoken thus to the Goddess, the radiant Rudra himself,
seeing Ruru, the lord of Asuras, fallen along with his army,
the Lord, the three-eyed god himself, sang a hymn of praise.

94.s:
rudra uvāca .
jayasva devi cāmuṇḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇi .
jaya sarvagate devi kālarātri namo'stu te .. 95.45 ..
94.d:
रुद्र उवाच ।
जयस्व देवि चामुण्डे जय भूतापहारिणि ।
जय सर्वगते देवि कालरात्रि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 95.45 ॥
94.m:
Rudra said:
"Be victorious, O goddess Cāmuṇḍā! Be victorious, O stealer of beings!
Be victorious, O all-pervading Goddess! O Kālarātrī, salutations to you!

94.s:
viśvamūrtte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocane .
bhīmarūpe śive vidye mahāmāye mahodaye .. 95.46 ..
94.d:
विश्वमूर्त्ते शुभे शुद्धे विरूपाक्षि त्रिलोचने ।
भीमरूपे शिवे विद्ये महामाये महोदये ॥ 95.46 ॥
94.m:
O you whose form is the universe, O auspicious one, pure one, deformed-eyed one, three-eyed one!
O you of terrifying form, auspicious one, wisdom, Mahāmāyā, of great fortune!

94.s:
manojave jaye jṛmbhe bhīmākṣi kṣubhitakṣaye .
mahāmāri vicitrāṅge geyanṛtyapriye śubhe .. 95.47 ..
94.d:
मनोजवे जये जृम्भे भीमाक्षि क्षुभितक्षये ।
महामारि विचित्राङ्गे गेयनृत्यप्रिये शुभे ॥ 95.47 ॥
94.m:
O swift as thought, victorious one, gaping one, fierce-eyed one, destroyer of the agitated!
O great pestilence, of manifold limbs, lover of song and dance, auspicious one!

94.s:
vikarāle mahākāli kālike pāpahāriṇi .
pāśahaste daṇḍahaste bhīmarūpe bhayānake .. 95.48 ..
94.d:
विकराले महाकालि कालिके पापहारिणि ।
पाशहस्ते दण्डहस्ते भीमरूपे भयानके ॥ 95.48 ॥
94.m:
O dreadful one, Mahākālī, Kālikā, remover of sin!
O you with a noose in hand, staff in hand, of terrifying form, frightful one!

94.s:
cāmuṇḍe jvalamānāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre mahābale .
śavayānasthite devi pretāsanagate śive .. 95.49 ..
94.d:
चामुण्डे ज्वलमानास्ये तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रे महाबले ।
शवयानस्थिते देवि प्रेतासनगते शिवे ॥ 95.49 ॥
94.m:
O Cāmuṇḍā, with blazing mouth, sharp-fanged one, possessing great might!
O Goddess mounted on a corpse, seated upon a ghost, auspicious one!

94.s:
bhīmākṣi bhīṣaṇe devi sarvabhūtabhayaṃkari .
karāle vikarāle ca mahākāle karālini .
kālī karālī vikrāntā kālarātri namo'stu te .. 95.50 ..
94.d:
भीमाक्षि भीषणे देवि सर्वभूतभयंकरि ।
कराले विकराले च महाकाले करालिनि ।
काली कराली विक्रान्ता कालरात्रि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 95.50 ॥
94.m:
O fierce-eyed one, terrible one, Goddess causing fear to all beings!
O dreadful one, highly dreadful one, Mahākāla, terrifying one!
O Kālī, Karālī, valorous one, Kālarātrī, salutations to you!

94.s:
vikarālamukhī devi jvālāmukhi namo'stu te .
sarvasattvahite devi sarvadevi namo'stu te .. 95.51 ..
94.d:
विकरालमुखी देवि ज्वालामुखि नमोऽस्तु ते ।
सर्वसत्त्वहिते देवि सर्वदेवि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 95.51 ॥
94.m:
O Goddess with a gaping mouth, flame-mouthed one, salutations to you!
O Goddess beneficent to all creatures, all-goddess, salutations to you!"

94.s:
iti stutā tadā devī rudreṇa parameṣṭhinā .
tutoṣa paramā devī vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha .
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva deveśa yat te manasi varttate .. 95.52 ..
94.d:
इति स्तुता तदा देवी रुद्रेण परमेष्ठिना ।
तुतोष परमा देवी वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ।
वरं वृणीष्व देवेश यत् ते मनसि वर्त्तते ॥ 95.52 ॥
94.m:
Thus praised at that time by Rudra, the highest Lord,
the supreme Goddess was pleased and indeed uttered this word:
"Choose a boon, O Lord of the gods, whatever is in your mind."

94.s:
rudra uvāca .
stotreṇānena ye devi tvāṃ stuvanti varānane .
teṣāṃ tvaṃ varadā devi bhava sarvagatā satī .. 95.53 ..
94.d:
रुद्र उवाच ।
स्तोत्रेणानेन ये देवि त्वां स्तुवन्ति वरानने ।
तेषां त्वं वरदा देवि भव सर्वगता सती ॥ 95.53 ॥
94.m:
Rudra said:
"To those who praise you with this hymn, O Goddess, O fair-faced one,
be the granter of boons, O Goddess, being omnipresent and true.

94.s:
yaścemaṃ triprakāraṃ tu devi bhaktyā samanvitaḥ .
sa putrapautrapaśumān samṛddhimupagacchati .. 95.54 ..
94.d:
यश्चेमं त्रिप्रकारं तु देवि भक्त्या समन्वितः ।
स पुत्रपौत्रपशुमान् समृद्धिमुपगच्छति ॥ 95.54 ॥
94.m:
And whoever [recites] this three-fold [hymn], O Goddess, endowed with devotion,
he, possessing sons, grandsons, and cattle, attains prosperity.

94.s:
yaścemaṃ śrṛṇuyād bhaktyā triśaktayāstu samudbhavam .
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam .. 95.55 ..
94.d:
यश्चेमं श्रृणुयाद् भक्त्या त्रिशक्तयास्तु समुद्भवम् ।
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पदं गच्छत्यनामयम् ॥ 95.55 ॥
94.m:
And whoever hears with devotion this origin of the three powers,
freed from all sins, goes to the sorrowless abode."

94.s:
evaṃ stutvā bhavo devīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ parameśvarīm .
kṣaṇādantarhito devaste ca devā divaṃ yayuḥ .. 95.56 ..
94.d:
एवं स्तुत्वा भवो देवीं चामुण्डां परमेश्वरीम् ।
क्षणादन्तर्हितो देवस्ते च देवा दिवं ययुः ॥ 95.56 ॥
94.m:
Having thus praised the Goddess, Cāmuṇḍā, the supreme sovereign, Bhava,
the god, vanished in an instant, and those gods went to heaven.

94.s:
ya etāṃ veda vai devyā utpattiṃ trividhāṃ dhare .
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati .. 95.57 ..
94.d:
य एतां वेद वै देव्या उत्पत्तिं त्रिविधां धरे ।
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः परं निर्वाणमृच्छति ॥ 95.57 ॥
94.m:
Whoever knows this threefold origin of the Goddess, O Earth,
is freed from all sins and attains supreme nirvāṇa.

94.s:
bhraṣṭarājyo yadā rājā navamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ .
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmupavāsī narottamaḥ .
saṃvatsareṇa labhate rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ nṛpaḥ .. 95.58 ..
94.d:
भ्रष्टराज्यो यदा राजा नवम्यां नियतः शुचिः ।
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यामुपवासी नरोत्तमः ।
संवत्सरेण लभते राज्यं निष्कण्टकं नृपः ॥ 95.58 ॥
94.m:
When a king fallen from his kingdom, self-restrained and pure on the ninth [lunar day],
and fasting on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days]—that best of men,
that king, obtains an untroubled kingdom within a year.

94.s:
eṣā triśaktiruddiṣṭā nayasiddhāntagāminī .
eṣā śvetā parā sṛṣṭiḥ sāttvikī brahmasaṃsthitā .. 95.59 ..
94.d:
एषा त्रिशक्तिरुद्दिष्टा नयसिद्धान्तगामिनी ।
एषा श्वेता परा सृष्टिः सात्त्विकी ब्रह्मसंस्थिता ॥ 95.59 ॥
94.m: This threefold power is thus proclaimed, following the established doctrine of logic. / This white [power] is the supreme creation, characterised by sattva, abiding in Brahmā.

94.s:
eṣaiva raktā rajasi vaiṣṇavī parikīrttitā .
eṣaiva kṛṣṇā tamasi raudrī devī prakīrttitā .. 95.60 ..
94.d:
एषैव रक्ता रजसि वैष्णवी परिकीर्त्तिता ।
एषैव कृष्णा तमसि रौद्री देवी प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ 95.60 ॥
94.m: This very [power] is red in rajas, known as Vaiṣṇavī; / this very [power] is black in tamas, proclaimed as the goddess Raudrī.

94.s:
paramātmā yathā deva eka eva tridhā sthitaḥ .
prayojanavaśācchaktirekaiva trividhā'bhavat .. 95.61 ..
94.d:
परमात्मा यथा देव एक एव त्रिधा स्थितः ।
प्रयोजनवशाच्छक्तिरेकैव त्रिविधाऽभवत् ॥ 95.61 ॥
94.m: Just as the god who is the supreme self, though one, abides threefold, / so the power, though one, becomes threefold according to need.

94.s:
ya etaṃ śrṛṇuyāt sargaṃ triśaktyāḥ paramaṃ śivam .
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt .. 95.62 ..
94.d:
य एतं श्रृणुयात् सर्गं त्रिशक्त्याः परमं शिवम् ।
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः परं निर्वाणमाप्नुयात् ॥ 95.62 ॥
94.m: Whoever hears this supreme, auspicious creation of the threefold power, / freed from all sins, attains supreme liberation.

94.s:
yaścedaṃ śrṛṇuyād bhaktyā navamyāṃ niyataḥ sthitaḥ .
sa rājyamatulaṃ lebhe bhayebhyaśca pramucyate .. 95.63 ..
94.d:
यश्चेदं श्रृणुयाद् भक्त्या नवम्यां नियतः स्थितः ।
स राज्यमतुलं लेभे भयेभ्यश्च प्रमुच्यते ॥ 95.63 ॥
94.m: And whoever hears this with devotion on the ninth day, remaining self-restrained, / obtains an unequalled kingdom and is freed from terrors.

94.s:
yasyedaṃ likhitaṃ gehe sadā tiṣṭhati dhāriṇi .
na tasyāgnibhayaṃ ghoraṃ sarpacaurādikaṃ bhavet .. 95.64 ..
94.d:
यस्येदं लिखितं गेहे सदा तिष्ठति धारिणि ।
न तस्याग्निभयं घोरं सर्पचौरादिकं भवेत् ॥ 95.64 ॥
94.m: In whose house this [text] constantly remains written, O Earth, / for him there is no terrible fear of fire, serpents, thieves, and the like.

94.s:
yaścaitat pūjayed bhaktayā pustake'pi sthitaṃ budhaḥ .
tena yaṣṭaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 95.65 ..
94.d:
यश्चैतत् पूजयेद् भक्तया पुस्तकेऽपि स्थितं बुधः ।
तेन यष्टं भवेत् सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥ 95.65 ॥
94.m: And the wise person who worships this with devotion, even when kept in a book, / by him has the whole threefold world, moving and unmoving, been worshipped.

94.s:
jāyante paśavaḥ putrā dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ .
ratnānyaśvā gajā bhṛtyā yānāścāśu bhavantyuta .
yasyedaṃ tiṣṭhate gehe tasyedaṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 95.66 ..
94.d:
जायन्ते पशवः पुत्रा धनं धान्यं वरस्त्रियः ।
रत्नान्यश्वा गजा भृत्या यानाश्चाशु भवन्त्युत ।
यस्येदं तिष्ठते गेहे तस्येदं जायते ध्रुवम् ॥ 95.66 ॥
94.m: Cattle, sons, wealth, grain, excellent wives, / jewels, horses, elephants, servants, and vehicles quickly come to be; / in whose house this remains, for him this certainly comes to be.

94.s:
śrīvarāha uvāca .
etadeva rahasyaṃ te kīrttitaṃ bhūtadhāriṇi .
rudrasya khalu māhātmyaṃ sakalaṃ kīrttitaṃ mayā .. 95.67 ..
94.d:
श्रीवराह उवाच ।
एतदेव रहस्यं ते कीर्त्तितं भूतधारिणि ।
रुद्रस्य खलु माहात्म्यं सकलं कीर्त्तितं मया ॥ 95.67 ॥
94.m: The venerable Varāha said: / This very secret has been proclaimed to you, O Earth; / indeed, the entire majesty of Rudra has been proclaimed by me.

94.s:
navakoṭyastu cāmuṇḍā bhedabhinnā vyavasthitā .
yā raudrī tāmasī śaktiḥ sā cāmuṇḍā prakīrttitā .. 95.68 ..
94.d:
नवकोट्यस्तु चामुण्डा भेदभिन्ना व्यवस्थिता ।
या रौद्री तामसी शक्तिः सा चामुण्डा प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ 95.68 ॥
94.m: Ninety million Cāmuṇḍās exist, differentiated by varied forms; / that power of Rudra, characterised by tamas, is proclaimed as Cāmuṇḍā.

94.s:
aṣṭādaśa tathā koṭyo vaiṣṇavyā bheda ucyate .
yā sā ca rājasī śaktiḥ pālanī caiva vaiṣṇavī .
yā brahmaśaktiḥ sattvasthā anantāstāḥ prakīrttitā .. 95.69 ..
94.d:
अष्टादश तथा कोट्यो वैष्णव्या भेद उच्यते ।
या सा च राजसी शक्तिः पालनी चैव वैष्णवी ।
या ब्रह्मशक्तिः सत्त्वस्था अनन्तास्ताः प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ 95.69 ॥
94.m: And one hundred and eighty million divisions of Vaiṣṇavī are mentioned, / which is that power of rajas and the protectress, Vaiṣṇavī; / the powers of Brahmā abiding in sattva are declared to be infinite.

94.s:
etāsāṃ sarvabhedeṣu pṛthagekaikaśo dhare .
sarvāsāṃ bhagavān rudraḥ sarvagaśca patirbhavet .. 95.70 ..
94.d:
एतासां सर्वभेदेषु पृथगेकैकशो धरे ।
सर्वासां भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वगश्च पतिर्भवेत् ॥ 95.70 ॥
94.m: In all these divisions, individually one by one, O Earth, / the Lord Rudra, all-pervading, is the husband of them all.

94.s:
yāvantyasyā mahāśaktyāstāvad rūpāṇi śaṃkaraḥ .
kṛtavāṃstāśca bhajate patirūpeṇa sarvadā .. 95.71 ..
94.d:
यावन्त्यस्या महाशक्त्यास्तावद् रूपाणि शंकरः ।
कृतवांस्ताश्च भजते पतिरूपेण सर्वदा ॥ 95.71 ॥
94.m: As many forms as this great power has, so many forms has Śaṅkara / assumed, and he constantly loves them as their husband.

94.s:
yaścārādhayate tāstu rudrastuṣṭo bhaviṣyati .
siddhyante tāstadā devyo mantriṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 95.72 ..
94.d:
यश्चाराधयते तास्तु रुद्रस्तुष्टो भविष्यति ।
सिद्ध्यन्ते तास्तदा देव्यो मन्त्रिणो नात्र संशयः ॥ 95.72 ॥
94.m: Whoever worships them, Rudra will be pleased with him; / those goddesses, then, fulfill [the desires of] the practitioner; of this there is no doubt.

94.s: .. iti śrīvarāhapurāṇe bhagavacchāstre pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 95 ..
94.d: ॥ इति श्रीवराहपुराणे भगवच्छास्त्रे पञ्चनवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 95 ॥
94.m: Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter in the venerable Varāha Purāṇa, a sacred scripture of the Lord.

95.s:
atha triśaktiraharaye raudrīvratam
.. śrīvarāha uvāca ..
yā sā nīla giri yātā tapase dhṛtamānasā ..
rodrī tamodbhavā śaktistasyāḥ śṛṇu dhare vratam .. 1 ..
95.d:
अथ त्रिशक्तिरहरये रौद्रीव्रतम्
॥ श्रीवराह उवाच ॥
या सा नील गिरि याता तपसे धृतमानसा ॥
रोद्री तमोद्भवा शक्तिस्तस्याः शृणु धरे व्रतम् ॥ 1 ॥
95.m: Now the observance of Raudrī for the destruction of the threefold power. / The venerable Varāha said: / She who went to the Blue Mountain, with mind resolved on asceticism, / that power Raudrī, arisen from tamas—listen to her observance, O Earth.

95.s:
tapaḥ kṛtvā ciraṃ kālaṃ pālayāmyākhalaṃ jagat ..
evamuddiśya paṃcāgniṃ sādhayāmāsa bhāminī .. 2 ..
95.d:
तपः कृत्वा चिरं कालं पालयाम्याखलं जगत् ॥
एवमुद्दिश्य पंचाग्निं साधयामास भामिनी ॥ 2 ॥
95.m: "Having performed asceticism for a long time, I shall protect the entire world"— / aiming thus, the woman mastered the five-fire [austerity].

95.s:
tarayāḥ kālāntare devyāstapanyāstapa uttamam ..
rurunama mahātejāḥ brahmadattavaro 'suraḥ .. 3..
95.d:
तरयाः कालान्तरे देव्यास्तपन्यास्तप उत्तमम् ॥
रुरुनम महातेजाः ब्रह्मदत्तवरो ऽसुरः ॥ 3॥
95.m: In the course of time, as that goddess was performing excellent asceticism, / an asura named Ruru, of great splendor, received a boon from Brahmā.

95.s:
samudramadhye ratnāḍhyaṃ puramasti mahāvanam ..
tatra rājā sa detyendraḥ sarvadevabhayaṅkaraḥ..4..
95.d:
समुद्रमध्ये रत्नाढ्यं पुरमस्ति महावनम् ॥
तत्र राजा स देत्येन्द्रः सर्वदेवभयङ्करः॥4॥
95.m: In the midst of the ocean, there is a city rich in jewels [surrounded by] a great forest; / there he, the lord of the Daityas, was king, terrifying to all the gods.

95.s:
anekaśatasāhasrakeṭiṭyuttarottaraiḥ ..
asurairanvitaḥ śrīmāndratīyo namuciryathā ..5 ..
95.d:
अनेकशतसाहस्रकेटिट्युत्तरोत्तरैः ॥
असुरैरन्वितः श्रीमान्द्रतीयो नमुचिर्यथा ॥5 ॥
95.m: Accompanied by many hundreds of thousands of millions of asuras, / the glorious one was like a second Namuci.

95.s:
kālena mahatā cāsau lokapālapurāṇyatha ..
jigīṣuḥ sainyasaṃvīto devairyuddhamarocayat .. 6..
95.d:
कालेन महता चासौ लोकपालपुराण्यथ ॥
जिगीषुः सैन्यसंवीतो देवैर्युद्धमरोचयत् ॥ 6॥
95.m: After a great length of time, wishing to conquer the cities of the guardians of the world, / surrounded by his army, he chose battle with the gods.

95.s:
uttiṣṭhatastasya mahāsurasya samudratoyaṃ vavṛthe'timātram ..
anekanakapradamīnajuṣṭamālāvayaparvatasānudeśān .. 7..
95.d:
उत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य महासुरस्य समुद्रतोयं ववृथेऽतिमात्रम् ॥
अनेकनकप्रदमीनजुष्टमालावयपर्वतसानुदेशान् ॥ 7॥
95.m: As that great asura set forth, the water of the ocean surged exceedingly, / [overflowing] regions of mountain slopes, filled with many crocodiles and large fish.

95.s:
antaḥsthitānekasurāri saṅkavādvicitravamayudhacitraśobham ..
bhīmaṃ balaṃ varmitacāruyodhaṃ viniryayau sindhujalādaśālāt ..8..
95.d:
अन्तःस्थितानेकसुरारि सङ्कवाद्विचित्रवमयुधचित्रशोभम् ॥
भीमं बलं वर्मितचारुयोधं विनिर्ययौ सिन्धुजलादशालात् ॥8॥
95.m: From the water of the ocean, from [that] abode, marched forth a formidable army, / shining with varied weapons and shields, crowded with many enemies of the gods, with armored, handsome warriors.

95.s:
tatra dvipā daityavarairupetāḥ samānaghaṇṭāyuta kiṃkiṇīkāḥ..
vinaryayuḥ svākṛtibhīpaṇāśca samatvamuccaiḥ khalu darśayantaḥ .. 9..
95.d:
तत्र द्विपा दैत्यवरैरुपेताः समानघण्टायुत किंकिणीकाः॥
विनर्ययुः स्वाकृतिभीपणाश्च समत्वमुच्चैः खलु दर्शयन्तः ॥ 9॥
95.m: There elephants mounted by excellent Daityas, with matched bells and tinkling ornaments, / terrifying in appearance, marched forth, displaying their lofty symmetry.

95.s:
aśvāstathā kāñcanapīṭhanaddhā roḍaistu yuktāḥ sitacāmaraiśca ..
vyavasthitāste samameva tu viniryayurlakṣaśaḥ koṭeśaśca ..10..
95.d:
अश्वास्तथा काञ्चनपीठनद्धा रोडैस्तु युक्ताः सितचामरैश्च ॥
व्यवस्थितास्ते सममेव तु विनिर्ययुर्लक्षशः कोटेशश्च ॥10॥
95.m: Likewise horses fastened with golden saddles, adorned with [bridles] and white chowries, / stood ready, and marched forth by the hundreds of thousands and tens of millions.

95.s:
rathā ravisyandanatulyavegāḥ sucakradaṇḍākṣatriveṇuyuktāḥ ..
suśakhayantrāḥ parapīḍatāṅgāścalatyanantāstvaritaṃ viśaktāḥ .. 11 ..
95.d:
रथा रविस्यन्दनतुल्यवेगाः सुचक्रदण्डाक्षत्रिवेणुयुक्ताः ॥
सुशखयन्त्राः परपीडताङ्गाश्चलत्यनन्तास्त्वरितं विशक्ताः ॥ 11 ॥
95.m: Chariots whose speed was equal to the chariot of the sun, fitted with good wheels, poles, axles, and triply-joined poles, / equipped with well-fashioned engines, distressing the bodies of the enemy, swiftly moved in endless numbers, fully empowered.

95.s:
tathaiva yodhāḥ sthagitetaretāstatarṣiko ye varatūṇapaṇiyaḥ ..
pade pade labdhajayāḥ prahāriṇo virejurucairasurānugā bhṛśam .. 12..
95.d:
तथैव योधाः स्थगितेतरेतास्ततर्षिको ये वरतूणपणियः ॥
पदे पदे लब्धजयाः प्रहारिणो विरेजुरुचैरसुरानुगा भृशम् ॥ 12॥
95.m: Likewise warriors covering one another, with excellent quivers in hand, / victorious at every step, striking out, followers of the asuras, shone forth greatly.

95.s:
deveṣu caiva bhareṣu vinirgatya jdāttataḥ ..
caturaṅgabalopetaḥ prāyādindrapuraṃ prati .. 13 ..
95.d:
देवेषु चैव भरेषु विनिर्गत्य ज्दात्ततः ॥
चतुरङ्गबलोपेतः प्रायादिन्द्रपुरं प्रति ॥ 13 ॥
95.m: And when the gods [fled], having come out from there, / endowed with a fourfold army, he advanced toward the city of Indra.

95.s:
yuyodha ca suraiḥ sāḍhe rudaityapatistathā .
sudūrmusaladheraiḥ śarairdaṇḍāyudhaistathā .. 14 ..
95.d:
युयोध च सुरैः साढे रुदैत्यपतिस्तथा ।
सुदूर्मुसलधेरैः शरैर्दण्डायुधैस्तथा ॥ 14 ॥
95.m: And that lord of the Daityas fought with the gods / using severe clubs, heavy arrows, and staff-weapons.

95.s:
janudairayāḥ surānsaṃkhya surāścaiva tathāsurān ..
evaṃ kṣaṇamatho yudhvā tadā devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 15 ..
95.d:
जनुदैरयाः सुरान्संख्य सुराश्चैव तथासुरान् ॥
एवं क्षणमथो युध्वा तदा देवाः सवासवाः ॥ 15 ॥
95.m: The Daityas [struck] the gods in battle, and the gods likewise [struck] the asuras; / thus having fought for a moment, then the gods together with Indra,

95.s:
asurainirjitāḥ sadyo dudruvurvimukhā bhṛśam ..
deveṣu caivagbhagreṣu vidvateṣu viśeṣataḥ .. 16 ..
95.d:
असुरैनिर्जिताः सद्यो दुद्रुवुर्विमुखा भृशम् ॥
देवेषु चैवग्भग्रेषु विद्वतेषु विशेषतः ॥ 16 ॥
95.m: vanquished by the asuras, turning their faces away, fled at once. / And the gods having been broken, fleeing in all directions,

95.s:
asuraḥ sarvadevānāmanvadhāvata vīryavān .
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve dravanto bhayāvahvalāḥ..17..
95.d:
असुरः सर्वदेवानामन्वधावत वीर्यवान् ।
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे द्रवन्तो भयावह्वलाः॥17॥
95.m: the mighty asura pursued all the gods. / Then all the hosts of gods, fleeing, bewildered by fear,

95.s:
nīle girivara jagmuryatra devī vyavāsthatā ..
rodī taporatā devī tāmasī śaktiruttamā .. 18 ..
95.d:
नीले गिरिवर जग्मुर्यत्र देवी व्यवास्थता ॥
रोदी तपोरता देवी तामसी शक्तिरुत्तमा ॥ 18 ॥
95.m: went to the Blue Mountain, the best of mountains, where the goddess was staying— / the goddess Raudrī devoted to asceticism, the highest power of tamas,

95.s:
saṃhārakāriṇī devī kālarātrīta tāṃ viduḥ ..
sā dṛṣṭvā tān tadā devāna bhayatrastānvicetasaḥ .. 19 ..
95.d:
संहारकारिणी देवी कालरात्रीत तां विदुः ॥
सा दृष्ट्वा तान् तदा देवान भयत्रस्तान्विचेतसः ॥ 19 ॥
95.m: the goddess who brings about dissolution, whom they know as Kālarātrī. / Seeing those gods then, terrified by fear, bewildered,

95.s:
mā bhepṭetyuccakaidevī tānuvāca surottamān ..
devyuvāca ..
kimiyaṃ vyākulā devā gatirva upalakṣyate .. 20 ..
95.d:
मा भेप्टेत्युच्चकैदेवी तानुवाच सुरोत्तमान् ॥
देव्युवाच ॥
किमियं व्याकुला देवा गतिर्व उपलक्ष्यते ॥ 20 ॥
95.m: "Do not fear!" the goddess said loudly to those best of gods. / The goddess said: / "What is this agitated plight that is observed of you, O gods?

95.s:
kathayadhvaṃ drutaṃ devāḥ sarvathā bhayakāra ṇam ..
devā ūcuḥ .
ayamāyāti daityendro rurubhīmaparākramaḥ .. 21..
95.d:
कथयध्वं द्रुतं देवाः सर्वथा भयकार णम् ॥
देवा ऊचुः ।
अयमायाति दैत्येन्द्रो रुरुभीमपराक्रमः ॥ 21॥
95.m: Tell quickly, O gods, the cause of [your] fear in every way." / The gods said: / "Here comes the lord of Daityas, Ruru of terrible valor.

95.s:
etasya bhātān rakṣasva tvaṃ devānparameśvāra ..
evamuktasa tadā devī bhīma parākamā .. 22 ..
95.d:
एतस्य भातान् रक्षस्व त्वं देवान्परमेश्वार ॥
एवमुक्तस तदा देवी भीम पराकमा ॥ 22 ॥
95.m: Protect the gods terrified of him, O supreme sovereign!" / Thus addressed then, the goddess of terrible valor

95.s:
jahāsa parayā prītyā devānāṃ purataḥ śubhā ..
tasyā hasuntyā vakrāttu baḍhyo devyo vārnaryayuḥ .. 23..
95.d:
जहास परया प्रीत्या देवानां पुरतः शुभा ॥
तस्या हसुन्त्या वक्रात्तु बढ्यो देव्यो वार्नर्ययुः ॥ 23॥
95.m: laughed with supreme delight in front of the gods, the auspicious one. / And from the mouth of her who was laughing, many goddesses came forth,

95.s:
yābhirviśvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ vikṛtābhairanekaśaḥ ..
pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāḥ pani payodharāḥ .. 24 ..
95.d:
याभिर्विश्वमिदं व्याप्तं विकृताभैरनेकशः ॥
पाशांकुशधराः सर्वाः सर्वाः पनि पयोधराः ॥ 24 ॥
95.m: by whom this universe was pervaded, in various deformed shapes, / all holding a noose and a goad, all with prominent breasts,

95.s:
sarvāḥ śūladharā bhīmāḥ sarvāścāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ ..
tāḥ saḥ kāṭiśo devyasta de. veṣṭaya saṃsthitāḥ .. 25..
95.d:
सर्वाः शूलधरा भीमाः सर्वाश्चापधराः शुभाः ॥
ताः सः काटिशो देव्यस्त दे। वेष्टय संस्थिताः ॥ 25॥
95.m: all bearing tridents, terrible, all holding bows, auspicious; / those goddesses by tens of millions stood encircling [them].

95.s:
yuyudhudānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ baddhatūṇā mahābalāḥ ..
kṣaṇena dānavavalaṃ tatsarvaṃ nihataṃ tu taiḥ ..26..
95.d:
युयुधुदानवैः सार्धं बद्धतूणा महाबलाः ॥
क्षणेन दानववलं तत्सर्वं निहतं तु तैः ॥26॥
95.m: They fought with the Dānavas, their quivers strapped on, possessing great strength; / in an instant that entire army of Dānavas was destroyed by them.

95.s:
devāśca sarve sampannā yuyudhunagaṃ balam ..
kālarācyā balaṃ caiva yacca devabalaṃ mahat .. 27 ..
95.d:
देवाश्च सर्वे सम्पन्ना युयुधुनगं बलम् ॥
कालराच्या बलं चैव यच्च देवबलं महत् ॥ 27 ॥
95.m: And all the gods assembled and fought against that army. / The army of Kālarātri, as well as the great host of the gods, 27

95.s:
tatsarvaṃ dānavabalamanayadyamasādanam ..
eka evaṃ mahādaityo rurustasthau mahāmṛdhe .. 28 ..
95.d:
तत्सर्वं दानवबलमनयद्यमसादनम् ॥
एक एवं महादैत्यो रुरुस्तस्थौ महामृधे ॥ 28 ॥
95.m: led that entire host of Dānavas to the abode of Yama. / Alone the great Daitya Ruru stood firm in the great battle. 28

95.s:
sa ca māyāṃ mahāraudrī rauvīṃ visasarja hai ..
sā māyā vavṛdhe bhīmā sarvadevapramodinī .. 29 ..
95.d:
स च मायां महारौद्री रौवीं विससर्ज है ॥
सा माया ववृधे भीमा सर्वदेवप्रमोदिनी ॥ 29 ॥
95.m: And he discharged a terrible, dread creative illusion of terror. / That fearful creative illusion expanded, bewildering all the gods. 29

95.s:
tayā vimohitā devāḥ sarve nidrā tu lebhire ..
devā ca triśikhenājau taṃ daityaṃ samatāḍayat .. 30 ..
95.d:
तया विमोहिता देवाः सर्वे निद्रा तु लेभिरे ॥
देवा च त्रिशिखेनाजौ तं दैत्यं समताडयत् ॥ 30 ॥
95.m: Bewildered by it, all the gods fell into sleep; / but the goddess struck that Daitya in battle with her trident. 30

95.s:
tayā tu tāḍitasyāsya daityasya śubhalocane ..
carmamuṇḍe ubhe samyak pṛthagbhute babhūvatuḥ..31..
95.d:
तया तु ताडितस्यास्य दैत्यस्य शुभलोचने ॥
चर्ममुण्डे उभे सम्यक् पृथग्भुते बभूवतुः॥31॥
95.m: When that Daitya was struck by her, O fair-eyed one, / both his hide and head were completely severed from one another. 31

95.s:
rustu dānavendrasya carmamuṇḍe kṣaṇādyataḥ..
apahṛtyāiradevī cāmuṇḍā tena sā'bhavatu ..32..
95.d:
रुस्तु दानवेन्द्रस्य चर्ममुण्डे क्षणाद्यतः॥
अपहृत्याइरदेवी चामुण्डा तेन साऽभवतु ॥32॥
95.m: Because the goddess instantly carried off the hide and the head / of the lord of Dānavas, Ruru, she became known on that account as Cāmuṇḍā. 32

95.s:
vāśca sarva sampanna yuyudhunica ..
sa ca māyāṃ mahā ithaṃ samatāḍayat .. 33
sarvabhūtamahāraudrī yā devī parameśvarī ..
saṃhāriṇī tu yā caiva kālarātriḥ prakīrtitā .. 33 ..
95.d:
वाश्च सर्व सम्पन्न युयुधुनिच ॥
स च मायां महा इथं समताडयत् ॥ 33
सर्वभूतमहारौद्री या देवी परमेश्वरी ॥
संहारिणी तु या चैव कालरात्रिः प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 33 ॥
95.m:
[…] all assembled and fought […]; / and she thus struck down the great illusion […]. 33

The goddess who is the supreme sovereign, extremely terrible to all beings, / and who is the destroyer, is proclaimed as Kālarātri. 33

95.s:
tasyā anucarā devyo baḍhyo'saṃkhyāta koṭayaḥ ..
tāstāṃ devīṃ mahābhāgoṃ parivārya vyavasthitāḥ .. 34 ..
95.d:
तस्या अनुचरा देव्यो बढ्योऽसंख्यात कोटयः ॥
तास्तां देवीं महाभागों परिवार्य व्यवस्थिताः ॥ 34 ॥
95.m: Her attendant goddesses numbered many uncounted millions; / they stood surrounding that highly fortunate goddess. 34

95.s:
yācayāmāsuravyagrāstāstāṃ devīṃ bubhukṣitāḥ ..
vayaṃ devi sudhārtāḥ smo dehi no bhojanaṃ śubhe .. 38..
evamuktā tadā devī dadhyā tāsāṃ tu bhojanam ..
na cādhyagacchacca yadā tāsāṃ bhojanamantikāt.. 36..
tato dadhyo mahādevaṃ rudraṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum .
so'pi dhyānātsamuttasthau paramātmā trilocanaḥ .. 37..
uvāca ca drutaṃ devīṃ kiṃ te kārya vivakṣitam ..
ihi devi varārohe yatte manasi vartate .. 38 ..
95.d:
याचयामासुरव्यग्रास्तास्तां देवीं बुभुक्षिताः ॥
वयं देवि सुधार्ताः स्मो देहि नो भोजनं शुभे ॥ 38॥
एवमुक्ता तदा देवी दध्या तासां तु भोजनम् ॥
न चाध्यगच्छच्च यदा तासां भोजनमन्तिकात्॥ 36॥
ततो दध्यो महादेवं रुद्रं पशुपतिं विभुम् ।
सोऽपि ध्यानात्समुत्तस्थौ परमात्मा त्रिलोचनः ॥ 37॥
उवाच च द्रुतं देवीं किं ते कार्य विवक्षितम् ॥
इहि देवि वरारोहे यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ॥ 38 ॥
95.m:
Hungry, they eagerly implored that goddess: / “O goddess, we are tormented by hunger! Give us food, O auspicious one!” 35

Addressed thus, the goddess then contemplated food for them; / but when she could find no food close at hand for them, 36

she then meditated upon Mahādeva, Rudra, the lord Paśupati. / He too arose from meditation—the supreme self, the three-eyed one— 37

and swiftly said to the goddess: “What matter do you wish to speak of? / Speak, O goddess of fair hips, whatever is in your mind!” 38

95.s:
devyuvāca ..
bhakṣyārthamāsāṃ deveśa kiñciddātumihārhasi ..
balātkurvanti māmetā bhakṣārthinyo maḥ balāḥ .. 39 ..
95.d:
देव्युवाच ॥
भक्ष्यार्थमासां देवेश किञ्चिद्दातुमिहार्हसि ॥
बलात्कुर्वन्ति मामेता भक्षार्थिन्यो मः बलाः ॥ 39 ॥
95.m: The goddess said: / “O lord of gods, you ought to grant something here for them to eat! / Seeking food, these mighty ones are putting pressure on me; 39

95.s:
anyathā māmapi balādbhakṣyāyaṣyanti tāḥ prabho ..
rudra uvāca ..
etāsāṃ śṛṇu deveśa bhakṣyamekaṃ mayoditam .. 40..
95.d:
अन्यथा मामपि बलाद्भक्ष्यायष्यन्ति ताः प्रभो ॥
रुद्र उवाच ॥
एतासां शृणु देवेश भक्ष्यमेकं मयोदितम् ॥ 40॥
95.m: otherwise, O lord, they will forcibly devour even me!” / Rudra said: / “O goddess, hear what I declare to be the single food for them, 40

95.s:
kathya mānaṃ varārohe kālarātre mahāprabhe ..
yā strī sagarbhā deveśi vanyastrīparidhānakam .. 41 ..
95.d:
कथ्य मानं वरारोहे कालरात्रे महाप्रभे ॥
या स्त्री सगर्भा देवेशि वन्यस्त्रीपरिधानकम् ॥ 41 ॥
95.m: as it is being explained, O lady of fair hips, O Kālarātri of great splendour! / A pregnant woman, O ruler of gods, who wears the garment of an outsider woman, 41

95.s:
paridhatte spṛśecāpi puruṣasya viśeṣataḥ ..
sa bhāgostu mahābhāgo kāsāñcitpṛthivītale .. 42 ..
anyāśchidreṣu vā'jñānāṃ gṛhītvā tatra vai bālam ..
labdhvā bhavantu suprītā api varṣaśatā pi .. 13 ..
95.d:
परिधत्ते स्पृशेचापि पुरुषस्य विशेषतः ॥
स भागोस्तु महाभागो कासाञ्चित्पृथिवीतले ॥ 42 ॥
अन्याश्छिद्रेषु वाऽज्ञानां गृहीत्वा तत्र वै बालम् ॥
लब्ध्वा भवन्तु सुप्रीता अपि वर्षशता पि ॥ 13 ॥
95.m:
or touches [the garments] of a man especially— / let that be the share, O highly fortunate one, of some [of them] on the earth! 42

Let others, seizing upon the flaws of ignorant people, seize the child there; / having obtained it, let them be well satisfied even for hundreds of years! 43

95.s:
anyāḥ sutigṛhe cchidraṃ gṛhṇīyustatra pūjitāḥ ..
nivasiṣyanti deveśa tathānyā jātahārikāḥ .. 44 ..
gṛhe kṣetre taḍāgeṣu vāpyudyāneṣu caiva hi ..
anyacitā rudantya yāḥ striyāstaṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ ..45..
95.d:
अन्याः सुतिगृहे च्छिद्रं गृह्णीयुस्तत्र पूजिताः ॥
निवसिष्यन्ति देवेश तथान्या जातहारिकाः ॥ 44 ॥
गृहे क्षेत्रे तडागेषु वाप्युद्यानेषु चैव हि ॥
अन्यचिता रुदन्त्य याः स्त्रियास्तष्ठन्ति नित्यशः ॥45॥
95.m:
Others would find a vulnerability in the lying-in chamber, and worshipped there, / they will dwell, O Lord of gods, and likewise others are thieves of newborns.

In the house, field, ponds, wells, and groves, / other women who weep on funeral pyres dwell constantly.

95.s:
tāsāṃ śarīrāṇyāviśya kacittṛptimavāpsyatha ..
evamuktvā tadā devī svayaṃ rudraḥ pratāpavān .. 46..
dṛṣṭvā ruruca sabamasurendra nipātitam ..
stutiṃ cakāra bhagavān svayaṃ devasrilocanaḥ.. 17..
rudra uvāca ..
jayasva devi cāmuṇḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇi ..
jaya sarvagate devi kālarātre namo'stu te .. 18 ..
viśvamutte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣa trilo cane ..
bhīmarūpe śive vedye mahāmāye mahodaye .. 19 ..
95.d:
तासां शरीराण्याविश्य कचित्तृप्तिमवाप्स्यथ ॥
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी स्वयं रुद्रः प्रतापवान् ॥ 46॥
दृष्ट्वा रुरुच सबमसुरेन्द्र निपातितम् ॥
स्तुतिं चकार भगवान् स्वयं देवस्रिलोचनः॥ 17॥
रुद्र उवाच ॥
जयस्व देवि चामुण्डे जय भूतापहारिणि ॥
जय सर्वगते देवि कालरात्रे नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 18 ॥
विश्वमुत्ते शुभे शुद्धे विरूपाक्ष त्रिलो चने ॥
भीमरूपे शिवे वेद्ये महामाये महोदये ॥ 19 ॥
95.m:
entering their bodies, you will attain some satisfaction.” / Having spoken thus to the goddess, the majestic Rudra himself, 46

seeing the corpse of Ruru, the lord of Asuras, struck down, / the Lord, the three-eyed god, uttered praise in person. 47

Rudra said: / “Be victorious, O goddess Cāmuṇḍā! Be victorious, O destroyer of spirits! / Be victorious, O omnipresent goddess! O Kālarātri, homage to you! 48

O release of the universe, O auspicious one, O pure one, O three-eyed Virūpākṣī, / of terrible form, auspicious, worthy to be known, O Mahāmāyā of great elevation! 49

95.s:
manojave jaye jṛmbhe bhīmākṣa kṣubhitakṣaye ..
mahāmāri vicitrāṅge jaya nṛtyapriye śubhe ..50..
95.d:
मनोजवे जये जृम्भे भीमाक्ष क्षुभितक्षये ॥
महामारि विचित्राङ्गे जय नृत्यप्रिये शुभे ॥50॥
